CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..section: =========== PLANILLA ENVELOPE - KEYED IN THE OPERATOR PORTAL, NOT IN THE DETAIL FILE ===========

CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..ES: Tipo y numero de documento del aportante
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..PosFile: Not in the detail file - keyed in the portal / returned by it
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..Explanation: COMPOSITE FIELD. The employer authenticates to the operador de informacion with the pair (document type, document number) plus a user document pair and a password; the aportante identity is then taken from the operator's registration record, not re-keyed per planilla. Composite Key: sub-field 1 = document type (NI for a legal person); sub-field 2 = the NIT without the check digit, without dots and without hyphens. PERSISTENCE: fixed for the life of the legal entity; it must be the SAME NIT used on the PILA planilla and on Formulario 350, because Simple S.A. offers to seed the cesantias planilla from the last PILA planilla paid for the selected year and the seed matches on this pair.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..QueryRA: DERIVED - not a field of the published detail layout. Mercans working identifier for a value the channel captures at planilla level, computes, or returns. ACH Colombia S.A. (SOI) 'Instructivo para elaboracion de planilla Cesantias' v2, code DDS-DES-INS-008 (_txt/soi_cesantias.txt).

CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..PosFile: Not in the detail file - keyed in the portal / returned by it
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..Explanation: A constant for this filing. The operator portals treat cesantias as one of the Pagos Complementarios a la Seguridad Social (PCSS) services and it is selected explicitly; selecting the wrong service produces a PILA planilla, not a cesantias planilla.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..QueryRA: DERIVED - not a field of the published detail layout. Mercans working identifier for a value the channel captures at planilla level, computes, or returns. ACH Colombia S.A. (SOI) 'Instructivo para elaboracion de planilla Cesantias' v2, code DDS-DES-INS-008 (_txt/soi_cesantias.txt).

CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..EN: Accrual year of the severance savings
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..PosFile: Not in the detail file - keyed in the portal / returned by it
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..Explanation: THE PERIOD OF THIS FILING IS A YEAR, NOT A MONTH. This is the single most important structural difference from every other Colombian payroll filing: the nomina electronica, Formulario 350 and PILA are monthly and keyed to a payment date, whereas the cesantias planilla is keyed to the accrual YEAR that closed on 31 December and is paid in the FOLLOWING February. A planilla built in February 2027 carries ano causado = 2026.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..QueryRA: DERIVED - not a field of the published detail layout. Mercans working identifier for a value the channel captures at planilla level, computes, or returns. ACH Colombia S.A. (SOI) 'Instructivo para elaboracion de planilla Cesantias' v2, code DDS-DES-INS-008 (_txt/soi_cesantias.txt).

CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..ES: Tipo de afiliacion de la planilla
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..PosFile: Not in the detail file - keyed in the portal / returned by it
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..Explanation: Three values exist - Agremiado (contributions for associated or unionised independents), Dependiente (contributions arising from an employment contract, payroll-deducted) and Independiente (a natural person contributing for themselves). For an employer filing this return it is ALWAYS Dependiente. The values offered depend on the aportante type under which the employer registered on the platform.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..QueryRA: DERIVED - not a field of the published detail layout. Mercans working identifier for a value the channel captures at planilla level, computes, or returns. ACH Colombia S.A. (SOI) 'Instructivo para elaboracion de planilla Cesantias' v2, code DDS-DES-INS-008 (_txt/soi_cesantias.txt).

CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..PosFile: Not in the detail file - keyed in the portal / returned by it
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..Explanation: Selected before the detail is loaded, because it changes the OUTPUT: SOI records that where the medio de pago is Pago Credito the system issues ONE PLANILLA NUMBER PER ADMINISTRADORA contained in the settlement, whereas an electronic payment (PSE) yields a single planilla number. The engine's reconciliation must therefore expect either one or many planilla numbers back for the same run. See E10.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..QueryRA: DERIVED - not a field of the published detail layout. Mercans working identifier for a value the channel captures at planilla level, computes, or returns. ACH Colombia S.A. (SOI) 'Instructivo para elaboracion de planilla Cesantias' v2, code DDS-DES-INS-008 (_txt/soi_cesantias.txt).

CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..PosFile: Not in the detail file - keyed in the portal / returned by it
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..Explanation: Optional free-text label. Both operator manuals mark it optional. Use it to carry the run identifier so that the returned planilla number can be tied back to the payroll run without relying on the portal's own chronology.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..QueryRA: DERIVED - not a field of the published detail layout. Mercans working identifier for a value the channel captures at planilla level, computes, or returns. ACH Colombia S.A. (SOI) 'Instructivo para elaboracion de planilla Cesantias' v2, code DDS-DES-INS-008 (_txt/soi_cesantias.txt).

CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..ES: Indicador de fondo unico para todos los empleados y fondo seleccionado
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..CondReason: If = Y the value of T09 (Codigo del Fondo de Cesantias) is IGNORED for every record and replaced by the single fund selected here. If = N, T09 governs. See T09, whose Conditional Reason back-references this field.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..PosFile: Not in the detail file - keyed in the portal / returned by it
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..Explanation: CONDITIONAL PAIR. Simple S.A. asks 'Deseas que las cesantias de todos los empleados incluidos en esta planilla sean enviadas a un solo fondo de cesantias?'. Answering YES overwrites the per-employee fund with one value for the whole planilla. For a real employer the answer is almost always NO, because the fund is the EMPLOYEE'S statutory choice (Ley 50 de 1990 art. 99 num. 3: 'en el fondo de cesantia que el mismo elija'). Answering YES to save keystrokes deposits other people's money into the wrong fund and does not discharge the obligation. Set to N and let T09 carry the per-employee value.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..QueryRA: DERIVED - not a field of the published detail layout. Mercans working identifier for a value the channel captures at planilla level, computes, or returns. ACH Colombia S.A. (SOI) 'Instructivo para elaboracion de planilla Cesantias' v2, code DDS-DES-INS-008 (_txt/soi_cesantias.txt).

CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..ES: Indicador de generacion a partir de la ultima PILA
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..PosFile: Not in the detail file - keyed in the portal / returned by it
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..Explanation: Simple S.A. offers to build the cesantias planilla from the contributor list of the last PILA planilla paid for the chosen year. Convenient and dangerous: the PILA population is the population that was PAID in a month, which is not the population ENTITLED to a cesantias deposit for the year - leavers who left in June are absent from the December PILA but are still owed a pro rata deposit, and salario integral employees are present in PILA but owed nothing. The engine must generate the population itself and set this to N.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..QueryRA: DERIVED - not a field of the published detail layout. Mercans working identifier for a value the channel captures at planilla level, computes, or returns. ACH Colombia S.A. (SOI) 'Instructivo para elaboracion de planilla Cesantias' v2, code DDS-DES-INS-008 (_txt/soi_cesantias.txt).

CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..ES: Respuesta al ajuste automatico de validacion Asofondos
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..CondReason: Presented only where the validation returns at least one difference. Where the report is empty the question is not asked. Depends on T05, T06, T07 and T08, which are the values validated; each of those back-references this field.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..PosFile: Not in the detail file - keyed in the portal / returned by it
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..Explanation: BOTH operators validate the surnames and names in the planilla against the affiliate base that ASOFONDOS delivers to the operadores de informacion ANNUALLY, and present a downloadable Excel difference report. Answering SI replaces the employer's values with the Asofondos values; answering NO keeps the employer's values. Answer NO and investigate: a mismatch is usually either a genuine misspelling in payroll master data (fix it at source, it will also be wrong on Formulario 220 and Formato 2276) or an affiliate whose fund record is stale. Silently accepting SI hides a master-data defect that recurs every year.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..QueryRA: DERIVED - not a field of the published detail layout. Mercans working identifier for a value the channel captures at planilla level, computes, or returns. ACH Colombia S.A. (SOI) 'Instructivo para elaboracion de planilla Cesantias' v2, code DDS-DES-INS-008 (_txt/soi_cesantias.txt).

CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..EN: Planilla number assigned by the operator
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..PosFile: Not in the detail file - keyed in the portal / returned by it
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..Explanation: OUTPUT, not input. Assigned when the settlement is finalised and printed on the pre-payment comprobante PDF. Store it per run - and note the cardinality trap in E05: with Pago Credito there is one number PER FONDO, so the store must be one-to-many. This number is the key for the later planilla recovery, the per-fund and per-affiliate reports and the audit trail that evidences compliance with the February deadline.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..QueryRA: DERIVED - not a field of the published detail layout. Mercans working identifier for a value the channel captures at planilla level, computes, or returns. ACH Colombia S.A. (SOI) 'Instructivo para elaboracion de planilla Cesantias' v2, code DDS-DES-INS-008 (_txt/soi_cesantias.txt).

CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..EN: Total value payable in the planilla
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..ES: Valor total a pagar de la planilla
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..PosFile: Not in the detail file - keyed in the portal / returned by it
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..Explanation: CONTROL TOTAL. Displayed on the settlement summary and on the comprobante. It must equal the sum of T14 across the detail records of the planilla; where the medio de pago splits the planilla per fondo, the sum of the per-fondo totals must equal the run total. This is the only arithmetic check the channel gives you - there is no header record in the file carrying a declared total, so a truncated upload is NOT self-detecting. Compare the returned total against the engine's own sum before paying.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..Rounding: Whole Colombian pesos. No decimals, no thousand separators, no sign. The published layout gives amount fields 9 integer positions, right-aligned and zero-filled, with a 4-position zero filler in front of each. Round the computed liquidation to the peso - do NOT round up to the next 100 as PILA requires (Decreto 1990 de 2016 art. 1 governs contributions, not the cesantias deposit), and do NOT round to the nearest 1,000 as Formulario 350 requires (ET art. 577). Blending the three conventions is the classic Colombian defect.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..QueryRA: DERIVED - not a field of the published detail layout. Mercans working identifier for a value the channel captures at planilla level, computes, or returns. ACH Colombia S.A. (SOI) 'Instructivo para elaboracion de planilla Cesantias' v2, code DDS-DES-INS-008 (_txt/soi_cesantias.txt).

CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..section: =========== DETAIL RECORD - IDENTIFICATION (published layout, campos 1 to 8) ===========

CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..PosFile: TXT positions 1-2 | XLS column not present
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..Explanation: Campo obligatorio, siempre debe ser 02. A CONSTANT, quoted verbatim from the published layout: every detail line of the unified cesantias file is a type-02 record. There is no type-01 header record and no trailer record in this layout - the aportante data and the period live in the portal envelope (E01 to E06), not in the file. Consequence: the file has NO declared record count and NO declared control total, so the engine must reconcile the returned planilla total (E11) against its own sum.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..QueryRA: Simple S.A. 'Manual Cesantias', s. 3.2, published fixed-width layout (_txt/pagosimple_cesantias.txt).

CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..PosFile: TXT positions 3-7 | XLS column not present
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..Explanation: Campo obligatorio where the data are uploaded as a flat file. Must START AT 00001 and be consecutive for the remaining records. Zero-padded to 5 positions, so the layout admits at most 99,999 employees in one planilla. Composite Key: positions 1-7 of every line are the record key - positions 1-2 the constant '02' and positions 3-7 the sequence - and the operator's structure validation reads them first, so an off-by-one sequence rejects the whole file before any content is validated.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..QueryRA: Simple S.A. 'Manual Cesantias', s. 3.2, published fixed-width layout (_txt/pagosimple_cesantias.txt).

CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..CondReason: Determines the validation applied to T04 (length, and the PEP 15-digit rule). T04 back-references this field.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..PosFile: TXT positions 8-9 | XLS column A
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..Explanation: ALPHABETIC two-character code, validated against the list printed in the layout: CC, CE, TI, PA, CD, SC, PE - and, in the XLS variant of the SAME manual, also PT (Permiso temporal). THIS IS NOT THE PILA CODE SET: PILA Registro Tipo 2 campo 3 uses the same two-letter mnemonics but a different admitted list, and Formulario 220 / Formato 2276 use DIAN NUMERIC document-type codes. The engine must hold one document type and three mappers. Note the SOI-documented length trap: where the document is a Permiso Especial de Permanencia the NUMBER (T04) must be exactly 15 digits.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..QueryRA: Simple S.A. 'Manual Cesantias', s. 3.2, published fixed-width layout (_txt/pagosimple_cesantias.txt).

CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..CondReason: Length and content validation depend on T03 (document type); a Permiso Especial de Permanencia must be exactly 15 digits. T03 back-references this field.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..PosFile: TXT positions 10-25 | XLS column B
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..Explanation: Obligatorio. RIGHT-ALIGNED, ZERO-FILLED to 16 positions - this is the only field in the layout with an explicit alignment rule and it is the one most often got wrong, because the XLS variant of the same layout takes the number LEFT-aligned with a 15-character maximum. Composite Key: together with T03 this pair is the join key for the employee across every Colombian artefact - nomina electronica NIE044/NIE045, PILA Registro Tipo 2 campos 3 and 4, Formulario 220 casillas 24/25, Formato 2276 numeral 2 - and it is also the key the operator uses to match the Asofondos affiliate base. Strip dots, commas, spaces and hyphens before padding. PERSISTENCE: stable for life except on a document-type change (TI to CC on reaching majority, PEP/PPT to CE on regularisation), which must be notified to the fund, or the deposit lands on an orphan account.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..QueryRA: Simple S.A. 'Manual Cesantias', s. 3.2, published fixed-width layout (_txt/pagosimple_cesantias.txt).

CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..CondReason: Validated as a SET with T06, T07 and T08 against the Asofondos base; the answer is given once, in E09, for the whole planilla. E09 back-references this field.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..PosFile: TXT positions 26-45 | XLS column C
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..Explanation: Obligatorio, supplied by the aportante. Left-aligned, space-filled to 20. Validated against the ASOFONDOS affiliate base (see E09) - a difference does not reject the file but raises a difference report the employer must answer SI or NO to. Strip accents and the special characters the operators reject; do not truncate silently, because a truncated surname produces a mismatch against the fund's record every single year.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..QueryRA: Simple S.A. 'Manual Cesantias', s. 3.2, published fixed-width layout (_txt/pagosimple_cesantias.txt).

CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..CondReason: Conditional on the person having a second surname; space-filled when absent. Validated as a SET with T05, T07 and T08 against the Asofondos base - see E09, which back-references this field.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..PosFile: TXT positions 46-65 | XLS column D
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..Explanation: Supplied by the aportante; the published layout does NOT mark it obligatorio, and the XLS variant states 'Campo Opcional - Hasta 20 caracteres'. Space-fill the whole 20 positions where the person has no second surname - do NOT shift the following fields up, because the record is positional and the fund code at 106-107 would then be read out of the name.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..QueryRA: Simple S.A. 'Manual Cesantias', s. 3.2, published fixed-width layout (_txt/pagosimple_cesantias.txt).

CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..CondReason: Validated as a SET with T05, T06 and T08 against the Asofondos base - see E09, which back-references this field.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..PosFile: TXT positions 66-85 | XLS column E
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..Explanation: Obligatorio, supplied by the aportante. Left-aligned, space-filled to 20. Both operators note that names are pre-loaded automatically from the Asofondos base held in their systems and are editable - which means the portal may DISPLAY a name the employer never sent.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..QueryRA: Simple S.A. 'Manual Cesantias', s. 3.2, published fixed-width layout (_txt/pagosimple_cesantias.txt).

CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..CondReason: Conditional on the person having a second name; space-filled when absent. Validated as a SET with T05, T06 and T07 against the Asofondos base - see E09, which back-references this field.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..PosFile: TXT positions 86-105 | XLS column F
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..Explanation: Supplied by the aportante; not marked obligatorio, and the XLS variant states 'Campo Opcional'. Maps to the Data-Dictionary Other_Names field, which is the same field that feeds nomina electronica OtrosNombres and Formulario 220 - keep one source of truth.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..QueryRA: Simple S.A. 'Manual Cesantias', s. 3.2, published fixed-width layout (_txt/pagosimple_cesantias.txt).

CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..section: =========== DETAIL RECORD - FUND, DAYS AND AMOUNTS (published layout, campos 9 to 14) ===========

CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..EN: Severance-savings fund code of the affiliate
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..ES: Codigo del Fondo de Cesantias al que pertenece el afiliado
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..CondReason: IGNORED where E07 (single-fund indicator) = Y, in which case the planilla-level fund overwrites this value for every record. E07 back-references this field.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..PosFile: TXT positions 106-107 | XLS column G
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..Explanation: Campo obligatorio, validated against the funds registered in the operator's system. The published layout admits exactly FIVE values and prints them: 02 Proteccion, 03 Porvenir, 10 Colfondos, 15 Fondo Nacional del Ahorro (FNA), 19 Old Mutual (antes Skandia). STALE LABEL, LIVE CODE: code 19's printed label is out of date - the entity trades as Skandia again (Skandia Administradora de Fondos de Pensiones y Cesantias S.A., authorised by the Superintendencia Financiera in January 2025 as SKANDIA AFP-ACCAI S.A. under Ley 2381 de 2024). Send the CODE, not the name. The fund is the EMPLOYEE'S choice under Ley 50 de 1990 art. 99 num. 3 and is master data on the employee, not a company default.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..OptionValues: -> Sheet 6: Codigo del Fondo de Cesantias
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..QueryRA: Simple S.A. 'Manual Cesantias', s. 3.2, published fixed-width layout (_txt/pagosimple_cesantias.txt).

CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..CondReason: Feeds the auto-calculation of T14 together with T12; the layout's formula is salario basico * (dias trabajados / 360). T12 and T14 back-reference this field.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..PosFile: TXT positions 108-110 | XLS column H
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..Explanation: Obligatorio. Admits values from 1 to 360 - a 360-DAY COMMERCIAL YEAR, not 365. A full year of service is 360, and every partial year is the actual days of service counted on the commercial convention (each month 30 days). Include the days of paid leave and of employer-paid or institution-paid incapacity, which count as service. The 3-position field cannot carry more than one year, which is the layout's way of saying that this filing is strictly one accrual year per record.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..QueryRA: Simple S.A. 'Manual Cesantias', s. 3.2, published fixed-width layout (_txt/pagosimple_cesantias.txt).

CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..EN: Zero filler before the salary field
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..CondReason: Immediately precedes T12 and is part of its 13-position amount frame; T12 back-references this field.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..PosFile: TXT positions 111-114 | XLS column not present
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..Explanation: Obligatorio - 'Debe contener ceros'. A four-position filler that exists only in the fixed-width variant; the XLS layout has no equivalent column. Read it together with campo 14's note, which explains the intent: 'antes de cada valor deben ir 4 espacios (pueden ser rellenos con ceros o en blanco)'. In other words the two amount fields are really 13 positions each, of which the leading 4 must be zeros or blanks. Write ZEROS, not blanks - the campo-11 rule is categorical where the campo-14 note is permissive, and zeros satisfy both.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..QueryRA: Simple S.A. 'Manual Cesantias', s. 3.2, published fixed-width layout (_txt/pagosimple_cesantias.txt).

CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..EN: Basic salary reported in the last month
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..ES: Salario basico reportado en el ultimo mes
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..CondReason: Framed by the T11 zero filler and feeds the auto-calculation of T14 with T10. T11 and T14 back-reference this field.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..PosFile: TXT positions 115-123 | XLS column I
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..Explanation: Obligatorio. Nine integers, no decimals, no commas, no points, not less than zero. The layout is explicit about WHICH salary: 'el ultimo salario basico reportado en el mes de diciembre del ano causado de cesantias'. THIS IS THE OPERATOR'S REPORTING FIELD, NOT THE STATUTORY BASE. CST art. 253 fixes the statutory base as the last monthly salary provided it has not varied in the last three months, otherwise the average of the last year of service (or of the whole period if shorter), INCLUDING the auxilio de transporte. The field name says 'basico' and the operator's calculator uses it alone - see the trap documented at T14. Report the December basic here and compute T14 yourself.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..Rounding: Whole Colombian pesos. No decimals, no thousand separators, no sign. The published layout gives amount fields 9 integer positions, right-aligned and zero-filled, with a 4-position zero filler in front of each. Round the computed liquidation to the peso - do NOT round up to the next 100 as PILA requires (Decreto 1990 de 2016 art. 1 governs contributions, not the cesantias deposit), and do NOT round to the nearest 1,000 as Formulario 350 requires (ET art. 577). Blending the three conventions is the classic Colombian defect.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..QueryRA: Simple S.A. 'Manual Cesantias', s. 3.2, published fixed-width layout (_txt/pagosimple_cesantias.txt).

CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..EN: Zero filler before the severance-savings value
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..CondReason: Immediately precedes T14 and is part of its 13-position amount frame; T14 back-references this field.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..PosFile: TXT positions 124-127 | XLS column not present
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..Explanation: Obligatorio - 'Debe contener ceros'. The second four-position filler, framing the amount at 128-136 exactly as T11 frames the amount at 115-123. Absent from the XLS layout. Write zeros.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..QueryRA: Simple S.A. 'Manual Cesantias', s. 3.2, published fixed-width layout (_txt/pagosimple_cesantias.txt).

CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..EN: Value of the severance savings deposited
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..CondReason: Framed by the T13 zero filler; auto-calculated from T10 and T12 if left blank, which must never be allowed. T10, T12 and T13 back-reference this field.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..PosFile: TXT positions 128-136 | XLS column J
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..Explanation: Obligatorio, nine integers. TWO RULES AND ONE TRAP. Rule one, the floor: 'el valor minimo del recaudo debe ser de un (1) dia de un (1) SMLMV del ano causado' - for accrual year 2026 one day of the SMMLV of COP 1,750,905 is COP 58,363.50, so a record below that is rejected. Rule two, the override: the layout's own formula is salario basico * (dias trabajados / 360) BUT 'en este campo el aportante puede especificar un valor diferente y no se haran calculos automaticos de este valor'. THE TRAP: the operator's formula omits the AUXILIO DE TRANSPORTE, which CST art. 253 requires in the base. For an employee on the 2026 minimum wage the operator would compute 1,750,905 while the statute requires (1,750,905 + 249,095) = 2,000,000 - a shortfall of COP 249,095 that is a SHORT DEPOSIT, penalised at one day's salary for every day of delay under Ley 50 de 1990 art. 99 num. 3, uncapped. ALWAYS write the engine's own figure into this field and never rely on the portal calculator. Where the monthly advance regime of MA01 is in use, this field carries the CONSOLIDATED annual figure and only the difference computed at MA05 is actually deposited in February.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..Rounding: Whole Colombian pesos. No decimals, no thousand separators, no sign. The published layout gives amount fields 9 integer positions, right-aligned and zero-filled, with a 4-position zero filler in front of each. Round the computed liquidation to the peso - do NOT round up to the next 100 as PILA requires (Decreto 1990 de 2016 art. 1 governs contributions, not the cesantias deposit), and do NOT round to the nearest 1,000 as Formulario 350 requires (ET art. 577). Blending the three conventions is the classic Colombian defect.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..QueryRA: Simple S.A. 'Manual Cesantias', s. 3.2, published fixed-width layout (_txt/pagosimple_cesantias.txt).

CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..section: =========== DETAIL RECORD - AFFILIATE CONTACT DATA (published layout, campos 15 to 20) ===========

CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..CondReason: Should be consistent with T16 and T17 (the DANE department and municipality of the same address); those two fields back-reference this one.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..PosFile: TXT positions 137-186 | XLS column K
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..Explanation: The employee's residential address, 50 positions, left-aligned and space-filled. This is the AFFILIATE'S address for the fund's own statutory communications with its member, which is why the layout asks for the residence and not the work address - contrast nomina electronica and PILA, which carry the WORK municipality. Do not send the work address; the fund will post the member's statements to it. Composite Key: the affiliate's domicile is carried across THREE fields that must describe one place - T15 the free-text street address, T16 the two-digit DANE department and T17 the three-digit DANE municipality. Within T15 itself, Colombian addresses decompose as via type (CALLE / CARRERA / DIAGONAL / TRANSVERSAL), via number, the NO separator, the cross-via number, the hyphen, the door number and any complement (APTO / TORRE / INT). Abbreviate by a documented rule where the whole exceeds 50 positions - never cut mid-token, because the fund cannot repair a truncated address.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..QueryRA: Simple S.A. 'Manual Cesantias', s. 3.2, published fixed-width layout (_txt/pagosimple_cesantias.txt).

CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..CondReason: Must be the department half of the same DANE divipola code whose municipality half is T17, and must correspond to the address in T15. T15 and T17 back-reference this field.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..PosFile: TXT positions 187-188 | XLS column L
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..Explanation: Two positions, per the DANE list. The DANE divipola code is hierarchical: the two-digit department prefix plus the three-digit municipality suffix form the five-digit municipality code (11 + 001 = 11001, Bogota D.C.). Composite Key: T16 and T17 must be written as the two halves of ONE divipola code, never picked from two different lists.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..QueryRA: Simple S.A. 'Manual Cesantias', s. 3.2, published fixed-width layout (_txt/pagosimple_cesantias.txt).

CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..CondReason: Must be the municipality half of the same DANE divipola code whose department half is T16, and must correspond to the address in T15. T15 and T16 back-reference this field.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..PosFile: TXT positions 189-191 | XLS column M
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..Explanation: Three positions, per the DANE list, and it is the SUFFIX only - not the five-digit code. Writing the full 11001 into a three-position field truncates to 110 and silently relocates the affiliate. Composite Key: see T16.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..QueryRA: Simple S.A. 'Manual Cesantias', s. 3.2, published fixed-width layout (_txt/pagosimple_cesantias.txt).

CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..CondReason: Conditional on a 7-digit landline being held for the employee; filled with spaces or zeros where only a mobile number exists. Paired in the layout with T19 as the affiliate's contact block; T19 back-references this field.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..PosFile: TXT positions 192-198 | XLS column N
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..Explanation: 'Solo admite 7 numeros' - exactly seven digits, so the field cannot carry a mobile number (10 digits in Colombia) nor a number written with the area code. Where only a mobile is held, the field must be zero- or space-filled rather than truncated; a truncated mobile is a wrong-number record on the fund's affiliate file.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..QueryRA: Simple S.A. 'Manual Cesantias', s. 3.2, published fixed-width layout (_txt/pagosimple_cesantias.txt).

CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..CondReason: Conditional on an e-mail being held. Paired in the layout with T18 as the affiliate's contact block; T18 back-references this field.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..PosFile: TXT positions 199-248 | XLS column O
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..Explanation: Fifty positions. The layout prints its own validation: letters A-Z, digits 0-9, hyphen, underscore, apostrophe and full stop are admitted in the local part; the @ is the mandatory indicator; the domain may contain only letters, digits and the hyphen, and the hyphen may be neither the first nor the last character of the domain. Composite Key: local-part + '@' + domain; the operator validates the three parts separately, so an address that merely 'looks' valid can still be rejected on the domain rule.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..QueryRA: Simple S.A. 'Manual Cesantias', s. 3.2, published fixed-width layout (_txt/pagosimple_cesantias.txt).

CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..PosFile: TXT positions 249-258 | XLS column P
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..Explanation: Format AAAA-MM-DD, ten positions INCLUDING the two hyphens - note that the published layout types this field N while its content is not purely numeric, so a strict numeric writer would emit 20190301 and shift nothing (the field is last) but would still fail the format validation. Composite Key: positions 249-252 year, 253 hyphen, 254-255 month, 256 hyphen, 257-258 day. THIS IS THE HIRE DATE OF THE CONTRACT, NOT THE START OF THE ACCRUAL PERIOD: for an employee hired in 2019 and reported for accrual year 2026 the value is still 2019-03-01, while T10 carries 360 days. Sending the 1 January of the accrual year here is a common defect and it corrupts the fund's seniority record.

It is the base of the Ley 52 de 1975 art. 1 interest. CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..Explanation: 12% per annum on the IN01 balance, pro-rated on days over 360. PAID TO THE EMPLOYEE DIRECTLY, IN THE MONTH OF JANUARY of the following year - not to the fund, and not in February. The two obligations have different payees, different deadlines and different penalties: failure to deposit the principal costs one day's salary per day of delay, whereas failure to pay the interest costs an indemnity equal to the interest owed, ONCE ONLY (Ley 52 de 1975 art. 1). The draft decree would add a further precision at art. 4: the interest is 'entregado directamente al trabajador dentro del mes siguiente a la fecha de liquidacion del auxilio de cesantia'. No interest on interest may be liquidated.

CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..ES: Fecha de pago de la planilla
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..PosFile: Not in the detail file - keyed in the portal / returned by it
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..Explanation: INBOUND. The date the planilla was actually PAID, which is the date that matters for the deadline - not the date the planilla was built. Both operators separate settlement from payment: the planilla is liquidated, a pre-payment comprobante is issued, and payment then follows by PSE or by credit. A planilla liquidated on 13 February and paid on 17 February is LATE. Store the payment date, not the liquidation date, as the compliance evidence. Composite Key: AAAA-MM-DD - positions 1-4 the year, 5 the hyphen, 6-7 the month, 8 the hyphen, 9-10 the day; the same 10-character date frame as T20, and the pair (E10 planilla number, E90 payment date) is the key of the compliance evidence held per accrual year.

Mercans working identifier for a value the channel captures at planilla level, computes, or returns. ACH Colombia S.A. (SOI) 'Instructivo para elaboracion de planilla Cesantias' v2, code DDS-DES-INS-008 (_txt/soi_cesantias.txt).

CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..ES: Estado de cumplimiento de la consignacion por empleado
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..PosFile: Not in the detail file - keyed in the portal / returned by it
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..Explanation: INBOUND / DERIVED. Per employee and per accrual year, one of ON TIME, LATE (with the day count), SHORT (with the shortfall) or DISCHARGED BY DIRECT PAYMENT. This is the field that quantifies the exposure, because the Ley 50 de 1990 art. 99 num. 3 penalty is one day's salary for EACH DAY of delay, PER EMPLOYEE, and uncapped - on 100 minimum-wage employees a fortnight's delay is of the order of COP 81.7 million. Recompute it from E90 against the deadline in the Report Matrix, and hold it for the employee's three-year limitation period (CST art. 488 as substituted by Ley 2466 de 2025 art. 62). Where E92 records a discharge by proven direct payment, set this field to DISCHARGED BY DIRECT PAYMENT instead of deriving it from E90 - see E92.

(SOI) 'Instructivo para elaboracion de planilla Cesantias' v2, code DDS-DES-INS-008 (_txt/soi_cesantias.txt).

CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..CondReason: Where = Y, no annual detail record is produced for that employee (campos 1 to 20 of the published layout are not written) and E91 is set to DISCHARGED BY DIRECT PAYMENT. E91 back-references this field.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..PosFile: Not in the detail file - keyed in the portal / returned by it
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..Explanation: CST art. 57 par. 4, added by Ley 2466 de 2025 art. 15, verbatim: 'Cuando el empleador acredite de manera fehaciente el pago directo al trabajador del valor correspondiente a las cesantias, dicho pago se considerara liberatorio de la obligacion, y no procedera sancion por no consignacion, salvo que se demuestre que el pago no se realizo en condiciones de libertad y que no fue utilizado en fines autorizados por la ley. No obstante, la afiliacion a Fondo de Cesantias es obligatoria.' Three limits the engine must respect: the discharge needs FEHACIENTE evidence, it is rebuttable on the freedom-and-purpose test, and it does NOT remove the duty to affiliate the employee to a fund. A DRAFTING NOTE on the citation: art. 15's enacting formula announces only 'los paragrafos 2 y 3' of CST art. 57, yet the published text prints a Paragrafo 4 and this is it - so cite CST art. 57 par. 4 as added by Ley 2466 de 2025 art. 15, and expect the discrepancy to be raised.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..QueryRA: DERIVED - not a field of the published detail layout. Mercans working identifier for a value the channel captures at planilla level, computes, or returns. ACH Colombia S.A. (SOI) 'Instructivo para elaboracion de planilla Cesantias' v2, code DDS-DES-INS-008 (_txt/soi_cesantias.txt).

CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..PosFile: Not in the detail file - keyed in the portal / returned by it
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..Explanation: INBOUND. Both operators issue reports after payment - por fondo, por afiliado and a consolidated informe completo, in PDF or Excel - and the fund itself issues the deposit certificate. CCG Module 10 records that the certificate is issued by the FUND but the EMPLOYER must be able to evidence it. Store the reference against E10 and E90; it is the primary evidence in a claim, and the employee's claim period runs three years.
CO-CESANTIAS-006-ConsignacionAnual-Spec..QueryRA: DERIVED - not a field of the published detail layout. Mercans working identifier for a value the channel captures at planilla level, computes, or returns. ACH Colombia S.A. (SOI) 'Instructivo para elaboracion de planilla Cesantias' v2, code DDS-DES-INS-008 (_txt/soi_cesantias.txt).

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.section: =========== DOCUMENT ENVELOPE - UBL EXTENSIONS AND SIGNATURE ===========

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Group element opening the UBL 2.1 extension area. It carries the XAdES-EPES advanced digital signature (ds:Signature) and any sector-specific additional information under Anexo Tecnico s.10.1. Generated by the signing component, never by payroll.

Advanced digital signature over the whole document, using an X.509 certificate issued by a certification authority accredited by ONAC. Signature policy, canonicalisation and the ClaimedRole (thirdparty or supplier) are fixed by Anexo Tecnico s.7. Validation rules s.6.1.3 reject a document whose signature does not verify.

The DIAN document-search URL with the CUNE as the key. Anexo Tecnico s.13.1 fixes the payload. If a graphical representation (payslip PDF) is issued, this QR must be printed at not less than 2 cm x 2 cm on EVERY page (Res. 000013 de 2021 art. 24 and Anexo s.13.1).

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Example: V1.0: Documento Soporte de Pago de Nomina Electronica
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: A CONSTANT. The element must carry this exact literal string, accents included. Validation rule NIE022 rejects any other value. Do not derive it, do not localise it, do not trim it.

Destination environment of the document, from Anexo Tecnico table 5.1.1: 1 = Produccion, 2 = Pruebas (habilitacion). It is ALSO one of the eleven inputs to the CUNE hash, so a document generated in test can never be replayed into production - the CUNE would differ.
Anexo Tecnico table 5.5.7: 102 = NominaIndividual (the payroll support document), 103 = NominaIndividualDeAjuste (the adjustment note). Also an input to the CUNE.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.ES: CUNE - Codigo Unico de Nomina Electronica
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: COMPOSITE KEY - position breakdown. The CUNE is the SHA-384 hexadecimal digest (96 hex characters) of ELEVEN concatenated inputs, in this exact order and with no separators (Anexo Tecnico s.8.1.1.1): [1] NumNE = Prefijo + Consecutivo (NIE012); [2] FecNE = FechaGen (NIE026, AAAA-MM-DD); [3] HorNE = HoraGen including the GMT offset (NIE027); [4] ValDev = DevengadosTotal (NIE187), decimal point, 2 decimals TRUNCATED, no thousand separators, no currency symbol; [5] ValDed = DeduccionesTotal (NIE188), same format; [6] ValTolNE = ComprobanteTotal (NIE189), same format; [7] NitNE = employer NIT (NIE033) without dots, hyphens or the verification digit; [8] DocEmp = employee document number (NIE045) without dots or hyphens; [9] TipoXML (NIE202); [10] Software-Pin - the secret PIN, which NEVER appears in the XML; [11] TipAmb = Ambiente (NIE023). PERSISTENCE: the CUNE is immutable once the document is validated. Any change to any of the eleven inputs produces a different CUNE and therefore a different document; corrections are made by an adjustment note carrying its own CUNE and referencing the original.
A CONSTANT. Must contain exactly the words 'CUNE-SHA384'. Declares the hash algorithm used for NIE024 so that a verifier can reproduce the digest.

Date on which the XML was generated, in Colombian time. Distinct from the payment date (NIE203) and from the settlement period (NIE004 / NIE005). It is input [2] to the CUNE, and it is the date against which the art. 8 deadline - transmission within the first 10 days of the month following the payment - is measured.

Time of generation INCLUDING the GMT offset. Colombia is UTC-05:00 all year and does not observe daylight saving, so the offset is always -05:00. Input [3] to the CUNE - a missing or wrong offset silently breaks the hash.

Anexo Tecnico table 5.5.1: 1 Semanal, 2 Decenal, 3 Catorcenal, 4 Quincenal, 5 Mensual, 6 Otro. IMPORTANT: this describes how the EMPLOYEE IS PAID; it does NOT change the document frequency. Res. 000013 de 2021 art. 3 requires ONE monthly document per employee whatever the pay cycle, so a quincenal payroll reports PeriodoNomina = 4 on a single monthly document.

ISO 4217 currency of the amounts. For a Colombian payroll this is COP. Res. 000013 de 2021 art. 26 makes the Colombian peso mandatory; another currency may be ADDED to a graphical representation but never substituted.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated only where 'Currency' (NIE030) is NOT COP. Bidirectional pair: NIE030 must be a non-COP ISO code for NIE200 to be present, and NIE200 must be absent when NIE030 = COP.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Market representative exchange rate against the Colombian peso, used only where the document is expressed in a foreign currency. Out of scope for a standard Colombian payroll; carried here for completeness because the schema permits it.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Example: Nomina correspondiente al mes de marzo de 2026
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Repeating free-text element (0-N). Not read by any validation rule. Useful for a human-readable period label on the graphical representation. Never place a monetary value here - it will not be picked up by the totals.

The employer's own internal employee code, echoed in the numbering block. Optional (0-1). Distinct from NIE063, which carries the same value inside the Trabajador element; keep both consistent or reconciliation against the HR master becomes ambiguous.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Optional in the schema, but mandatory in practice wherever the employer has been authorised a prefix range. Bidirectional pair with 'Document number' (NIE012): NIE012 must equal Prefijo concatenated with Consecutivo (NIE011), so a Prefijo that is present here must reappear in NIE012.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Alphabetic prefix of the authorised numbering range, assigned to the employer by DIAN at enablement. Payroll never invents it.

Strictly increasing sequence within the authorised range. Global validation rule 90 permits a given document number to be transmitted only ONCE per employee, so the engine must persist the last-used consecutive and must never reuse it, even after a rejection.

COMPOSITE KEY - position breakdown. Numero = Prefijo (NIE010) immediately followed by Consecutivo (NIE011), with NO spaces and NO hyphens (the annex says so expressly). Sub-field 1 = the DIAN-authorised alphabetic prefix; sub-field 2 = the numeric consecutive. PERSISTENCE: unique per employee for the life of the range; it is input [1] to the CUNE, so it can never be re-issued after transmission.
Country in which the document was generated. Table 5.4.1. Almost always CO; it may legitimately differ where a shared service centre generates outside Colombia, which does not change the obligation.
Two-digit DANE DIVIPOLA department code (table 5.4.2). 11 = Bogota D.C. Must be the first two digits of the municipality code in NIE015.

COMPOSITE KEY - position breakdown. Five-digit DANE DIVIPOLA code: positions 1-2 = department code (must equal NIE014), positions 3-5 = municipality within that department. 11001 = Bogota D.C. The annex prints the full municipality catalogue at table 5.4.3.
ISO 639-1 two-letter language code. For Colombia this is 'es'. Res. 000013 de 2021 art. 26 makes Spanish mandatory on the graphical representation; another language may be added, never substituted.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated where the provider is a legal person. Mutually exclusive with the provider natural-person name fields NIE206-NIE209: populate RazonSocial OR the four name fields, never both.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Corporate name of the technology provider that generated and transmits the document. Where Mercans generates on the client's behalf, Res. 000013 de 2021 art. 22 additionally requires the provider to be enabled by DIAN, registered in the RUT, and both parties to retain the mandate document.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated only where the provider is a natural person. Mutually exclusive with provider 'RazonSocial' (NIE205).
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: First surname of a natural-person provider. Not used where Mercans (a legal person) is the provider.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated only where the provider is a natural person. Mutually exclusive with provider 'RazonSocial' (NIE205).
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Second surname of a natural-person provider. Not used for a legal-person provider.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated only where the provider is a natural person. Mutually exclusive with provider 'RazonSocial' (NIE205).
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: First given name of a natural-person provider.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated only where the provider is a natural person. Mutually exclusive with provider 'RazonSocial' (NIE205).
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Remaining given names of a natural-person provider.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Format: N (no dots, no hyphens, no DV)
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Tax identification number of the software provider, without separators and WITHOUT the verification digit (which goes in NIE018). Where the employer generates its own documents, this equals the employer NIT (NIE033).
The DIAN check digit of the provider NIT, computed by the standard weighted modulus-11 algorithm. Carried separately from the NIT itself in every DIAN artefact.

GUID of the software enabled by DIAN for the issue of the payroll support document. Assigned at software activation. Global validation rule 92 rejects any document from an issuer or software that is not enabled.

COMPOSITE KEY - position breakdown. SHA-384 digest of three concatenated inputs (Anexo Tecnico s.8.2): [1] SoftwareID (NIE019), [2] the secret software PIN - which never appears in the XML, [3] the document number (NIE012). PERSISTENCE: it therefore changes with EVERY document, unlike the SoftwareID which is constant. Treat the PIN as a secret of restricted circulation; it is also input [10] to the CUNE.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated where the employer is a legal person. Mutually exclusive with the employer natural-person name fields NIE210-NIE213: populate RazonSocial OR the four name fields, never both.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Registered corporate name exactly as held in the RUT. Item 1 of the thirteen mandatory content items of Res. 000013 de 2021 art. 5.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated only where the employer is a natural person. Mutually exclusive with employer 'RazonSocial' (NIE032).
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: First surname where the employer is an individual (a natural-person employer is common in Colombian domestic service and micro-enterprise).

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated only where the employer is a natural person. Mutually exclusive with employer 'RazonSocial' (NIE032).
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Second surname of a natural-person employer.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated only where the employer is a natural person. Mutually exclusive with employer 'RazonSocial' (NIE032).
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: First given name of a natural-person employer.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated only where the employer is a natural person. Mutually exclusive with employer 'RazonSocial' (NIE032).
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Remaining given names of a natural-person employer.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Format: N (no dots, no hyphens, no DV)
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Tax identification number of the employer issuing the document, without dots, hyphens or the verification digit. It is input [7] to the CUNE and the join key to Formulario 350, Formulario 220 and PILA. Item 1 of the art. 5 mandatory content.
DIAN check digit of the employer NIT. Deliberately excluded from the CUNE input, which uses the NIT alone - a frequent source of hash mismatches.
Country of the employer. Item 11 of the art. 5 mandatory content (country, department and municipality of origin).
Two-digit DIVIPOLA department of the employer. Must be the first two digits of NIE037.
COMPOSITE KEY - position breakdown: positions 1-2 = department (= NIE036), positions 3-5 = municipality. Sourced from the DANE DIVIPOLA catalogue reproduced at annex table 5.4.3.
Street address of the employer as registered. Free text; the annex imposes no structure. Part of art. 5 item 11.

Annex table 5.5.3 - a SIXTEEN-value list (01, 02, 04, 12, 18, 19, 21, 22, 23, 30, 31, 47, 51, 54, 56, 58). It is a SUBSET of the PILA tipo cotizante list, which has far more values, so the engine must map, not copy: PILA codes with no DIAN equivalent (for example 03 independiente, 16, 20, 32-45, 52, 53, 55, 57, 59-63) are not valid here.

Annex table 5.5.4 recognises only TWO values: 00 No Aplica and 01 Dependiente pensionado por vejez activo. This is much narrower than the twelve-value PILA subtipo list; an employed old-age pensioner is 01, everyone else is 00.

Whether the employee performs an activity classified as high-risk under Decreto Ley 2090 de 2003, which carries an ADDITIONAL employer pension contribution and a reduced pension age. Always present (1-1); write the literal true or false. See scope_manifest CO-GAP-02: the 2026 additional rate and its base require RA confirmation before any high-risk employee is configured.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.QueryRA: CO-GAP-02: confirm the 2026 additional high-risk pension rate and its base against the current implementing decree before configuring any high-risk employee.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Annex table 5.2.1: 11 Registro civil, 12 Tarjeta de identidad, 13 Cedula de ciudadania, 21 Tarjeta de extranjeria, 22 Cedula de extranjeria, 31 NIT, 41 Pasaporte, 42 Documento de identificacion extranjero, 47 PEP, 50 NIT de otro pais, 91 NUIP (employee only). NOTE CO-GAP-06: there is NO code for the PPT (Permiso por Proteccion Temporal, Decreto 216 de 2021), created one month after this annex; 47 (PEP) is the only available proxy.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.QueryRA: CO-GAP-06: confirm the client's position on reporting PPT holders under code 47 (PEP).

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Identity document number without dots or hyphens. It is input [8] to the CUNE and the join key to Formulario 220 and Formato 2276. CO-GAP-07 - KNOWN SCHEMA DEFECT: the XSD types this attribute as xsd:integer, so a passport or foreign identity document containing letters (document types 21, 41, 42, 50) cannot be schema-valid. DIAN has published no workaround; escalate per client.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.QueryRA: CO-GAP-07: xsd:integer typing blocks alphanumeric foreign document numbers. Confirm the client-specific escalation route with DIAN.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: First surname. Item 2 of the art. 5 mandatory content.

Second surname. CO-GAP-07 - KNOWN SCHEMA DEFECT: this attribute is use=required, yet many Colombians and virtually all foreign nationals have only one surname. Mercans emits a placeholder; no official workaround is published.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.QueryRA: CO-GAP-07: confirm the client's chosen placeholder for a single-surname employee.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: First given name. Mandatory (1-1).
Remaining given names. The ONLY optional (0-1) name attribute on the employee - the two surnames and the first name are all required.

Country where the work is performed. Materially important for tax: employment income of a NON-RESIDENT for work performed entirely OUTSIDE Colombia is foreign-source and not subject to Colombian withholding (DIAN Oficio 28380 of 2019), whereas a resident is taxed on worldwide income.
DIVIPOLA department of the place of work. Should reconcile to PILA Registro Tipo 2 field 9 (codigo del departamento de la ubicacion laboral) for the same employee and month.
COMPOSITE KEY - positions 1-2 = department (= NIE051), positions 3-5 = municipality. Reconciles to PILA Registro Tipo 2 field 10.
Street address of the place of work. For a teleworker this is the agreed remote workplace, not the employer's registered office.

Whether the employee is on an all-inclusive salary under CST art. 132 num. 2 (minimum 13 SMMLV = COP 22,761,765 in 2026, of which 70% is salary and 30% is the prestacional factor). Where true, the contribution base is 70% of the integral salary and no separate prima, cesantias or interest accrues - which changes what may legitimately appear in the Devengados block.

Annex table 5.5.2: 1 Termino Fijo, 2 Termino Indefinido, 3 Obra o Labor, 4 Aprendizaje, 5 Practicas o Pasantias. Ley 2466 de 2025 art. 21 recast the apprenticeship as a labour contract, so code 4 now denotes a genuine employment relationship.

The CONTRACTUAL monthly salary, not the amount actually paid for the period. It stays constant across a month with unpaid leave or a mid-month hire, whereas SueldoTrabajado (NIE070) moves. Never below 1 SMMLV (COP 1,750,905 in 2026) for a full-time employee.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: The employer's own payroll number for the employee. Optional. Keep consistent with NIE009, which carries the same value in the numbering block.
Annex table 5.3.3.1. The table publishes a SINGLE value, 1 = Contado (cash / immediate). Item 10 of the art. 5 mandatory content (payment method and medium).

Annex table 5.3.3.2 - the full UN/EDIFACT 4461 medium-of-payment list (1 to 97). For a Colombian salary the realistic values are 42 Consignacion bancaria, 45 Transferencia Credito Bancario, 10 Efectivo and 20 Cheque. Item 10 of the art. 5 mandatory content.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated where 'Payment method' (NIE065) is a bank-mediated medium (42, 45, 46, 47, 48, 49 and similar). Must be absent or empty where NIE065 = 10 Efectivo. Bidirectional pair with NIE065 and with 'Account number' (NIE068).
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Name of the receiving bank. Free text - Colombia has no national bank-code catalogue in this annex, and the clearing-house entity codes used in the bank payment file are bank-specific and obtained per client.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated together with 'Bank' (NIE066) and 'Account number' (NIE068) whenever 'Payment method' (NIE065) is a bank-mediated medium. Absent for a cash payment.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Ahorros (savings) or Corriente (current). Free text in the annex; standardise it at configuration so the value is stable across the payment file and the XML.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated together with 'Bank' (NIE066) and 'Account type' (NIE067) whenever 'Payment method' (NIE065) is a bank-mediated medium. Absent for a cash payment.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Domestic account number. COLOMBIA DOES NOT USE IBAN. Account numbers are numeric, of bank-specific length (commonly 10-17 digits) with no national check-digit standard, so the engine cannot validate them structurally - only by bank-specific rule or by pre-notification.

Repeating element, cardinality 1-N: one occurrence per actual payment inside the reported month. A quincenal payroll reports TWO FechaPago values on ONE monthly document. Item 5 of the art. 5 mandatory content, and the date that fixes the art. 8 transmission deadline.
Date the employee joined the employer. Constant across every document for that relationship; it drives TiempoLaborado (NIE006), the cesantias accrual and the seniority-based severance calculation.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated only on the document for the month in which the employment relationship ends. Where present, it must fall inside or before the settlement window bounded by 'Settlement start' (NIE004) and 'Settlement end' (NIE005).
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Leaving date. Cardinality 0-1. Its presence signals the final settlement document, which typically also carries VacacionesCompensadas, Cesantias, Indemnizacion and BonifRetiro devengado elements that do not appear in an ordinary month.
First day of the period the document settles. For the standard monthly document this is the first day of the calendar month, or the hire date in a joining month.
Last day of the settled period. Must be on or after NIE004. One document per employee per month whatever the pay cycle (art. 3).

COMPOSITE VALUE - construction rule. Cumulative service with the employer expressed in DAYS on the Colombian commercial-year convention fixed by Anexo Tecnico s.8.3.1: 1 year = 360 days, 1 month = 30 days. The annex's own worked example is 5 years + 3 months + 18 days = (5 x 360) + (3 x 30) + 18 = 1908.00. Sub-fields: [years x 360] + [months x 30] + [odd days]. PERSISTENCE: recomputed every month from FechaIngreso (NIE002) to the settlement end; it is cumulative service, NOT days worked in the period (that is DiasTrabajados, NIE069).
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Two decimals, per the annex example (1908.00).

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: The generation date repeated inside the Periodo element, considering the Colombian time zone (UTC-05:00). Must equal NIE026; a mismatch between the two is a common rejection.

Days actually worked and paid in the period, on the 30-day commercial month. Distinct from TiempoLaborado (NIE006), which is cumulative service. Reduced by unpaid leave, by suspension and by a mid-month hire or leave.

The basic salary actually earned for the days worked. Moves with DiasTrabajados; contrast Sueldo (NIE062), which is the static contractual figure. This is the single largest input to the ET art. 388 depurated withholding base and to the PILA contribution base.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Payable ONLY where the employee earns up to 2 SMMLV (COP 3,501,810 in 2026) - Ley 15 de 1959 and the annual transport-allowance decree. Where the employee is above the threshold this element is omitted, not zero-filled.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: The statutory transport allowance, COP 249,095 per month in 2026. It is NOT salary for contribution purposes but IS included in the base of cesantias, prima and the severance indemnity (CST art. 7 of Ley 1 de 1963) - one of the sharpest base differences in Colombian payroll.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Paired salary / non-salary element. Populate the S element for the PERMANENT portion of viaticos, which is salary under CST art. 130; the accidental portion goes to the NS element (NIE073). Bidirectional pair - the split must be decided at wage-type configuration, never derived at reporting time.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Permanent travel, meal and accommodation allowances that constitute salary and therefore enter the contribution base and the withholding base.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Paired with 'Travel and accommodation allowance - salary' (NIE072). Populate NS for the accidental / occasional portion, which is not salary under CST art. 130.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Accidental travel allowances that are not salary. Still reported, still part of the accrued total, but excluded from the contribution base - subject to the 40% non-salary clamp of Ley 1393 de 2010 art. 30.
