CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.EN: Night surcharge hour, Sunday / public holiday - percentage
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.ES: Hora Recargo Nocturno Dominical y Festivos - Porcentaje
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: The premium percentage applied. Anexo Tecnico table 5.5.5 assigns code 7 to 'Hora Recargo Nocturno Dominical y Festivos' with printed percentage 110.00. This is the only place the XML carries the rate; the amount in @Pago must be consistent with it.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Rate expressed to 2 decimals, not rounded by the payroll engine.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.QueryRA: SOURCE CONFLICT, escalate. Anexo Tecnico table 5.5.5 hard-codes the Sunday / holiday surcharge at 75.00 and the derived Sunday / holiday overtime rates at 100.00 / 150.00 / 110.00. Those figures pre-date Ley 2101 de 2021 and Ley 2466 de 2025, under which the Sunday and public-holiday surcharge steps to 80% on 1 July 2025 and to 90% on 1 JULY 2026. From 1 July 2026 the statutory surcharge (90%) therefore no longer equals the annex value (75.00). The annex is still at version 1.0 and DIAN has not reissued table 5.5.5. Confirm with the RA whether DIAN expects the ANNEX code percentage or the STATUTORY percentage in @Porcentaje.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.EN: Night surcharge hour, Sunday / public holiday - amount
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.ES: Hora Recargo Nocturno Dominical y Festivos - Pago
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Money value of the block. Base for the hourly rate is the ordinary hourly wage; note that the hourly divisor changes from 220 to 210 on 15 July 2026 as the working week steps to 42 hours (Ley 2101 de 2021), so the engine must stamp the divisor used.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Optional (0-1) but required by the RA where vacation is reported, and pairs with 'Vacation taken - end date' (NIE110): if one is present the other must be.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: First day of the vacation period actually enjoyed. Repeating block (0-N) - two separate vacation stretches in one month are two elements.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Pairs with 'Vacation taken - start date' (NIE109); required whenever NIE109 is present.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Last day of the vacation period enjoyed. Must be on or after NIE109.
Number of vacation days enjoyed. Colombia grants 15 WORKING days per year of service (CST art. 186); the accumulation limits of CST art. 190 are an engine rule, not an XML rule.
Money value of the vacation enjoyed. Vacation pay IS part of the contribution base; note that vacation is paid on ordinary salary excluding overtime (CST art. 192).
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Vacation days paid in cash instead of enjoyed. A SEPARATE element from vacation taken, because compensated vacation is NOT part of the social-security contribution base while enjoyed vacation is - the engine must not merge them.
Cash value of the compensated vacation days. Typical on a final settlement.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Days of service on which the statutory service bonus (prima de servicios, CST art. 306) is computed. Paid in two instalments, by 30 June and by 20 December.

The statutory service bonus. Under Procedure 1 the STATUTORY MINIMUM bonus is withheld SEPARATELY on its own read of the ET art. 383 table (art. 385) - it does not merge into the ordinary monthly base. Any excess over the statutory minimum is ordinary income.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated only for the extra-legal, non-salary portion of a bonus agreed as non-salary. Pairs with 'Service bonus - amount (salary)' (NIE118): the salary and non-salary portions are separate elements and must never be summed into one.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Non-salary portion of a bonus. Counts toward the 40% non-salary clamp of Ley 1393 de 2010 art. 30 for contribution purposes.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Severance savings (auxilio de cesantia, CST art. 249 / Ley 50 de 1990 art. 99): one month's salary per year of service. EXCLUDED from the monthly withholding base under both procedures because of the ET art. 206 num. 4 exemption and its taper. Cross-report: this is the figure that must reconcile to Formulario 220 casillas 47-49 and to Formato 2276 numerals 18-20.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: The statutory interest rate on severance savings: 12% per annum, or pro rata for a partial year (Ley 52 de 1975 art. 1). A CONFIGURATION constant, not a payroll calculation.

Interest on severance savings, payable TO THE EMPLOYEE during January for the balance at the preceding 31 December. Ley 2466 de 2025 art. 64 additionally permits monthly payment of the 1% by written agreement, which the engine must support as a configurable option.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Optional (0-1); pairs with 'Incapacity - end date' (NIE124). Where one is present the other must be present.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: First day of the incapacity. Repeating block (0-N): one element per incapacity episode, and an episode that changes type mid-way is split.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Pairs with 'Incapacity - start date' (NIE123); required whenever NIE123 is present.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Last day of the incapacity episode.
Days of incapacity in the episode. Must reconcile to the PILA change-event day counts (IGE, IRL) for the same employee and month.

Annex table 5.5.6: 1 Comun (general illness, funded by the EPS after the employer's first two days), 2 Profesional, 3 Laboral (both funded by the ARL from day one). The code determines who bears the cost, so it must be set from the medical certificate, not defaulted.

Amount paid to the employee for the incapacity. Colombian employers universally ADVANCE the benefit and recover it from the EPS or ARL, so this line is paid to the employee but receivable from the institution - see the inbound EPS/ARL determination in the Report Matrix. CO-GAP-03 / CO-GAP-04: the employer's first-two-days rate (Mercans default 66.67%) and the one-minimum-wage floor are configurable and require the client's election.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.QueryRA: CO-GAP-03 / CO-GAP-04: confirm the client's election on the first-two-days rate and on the minimum-wage floor for incapacity payments.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Optional (0-1); pairs with 'Maternity / paternity leave - end date' (NIE129).
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: First day of maternity or paternity leave. Funded by the EPS, advanced by the employer.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Pairs with 'Maternity / paternity leave - start date' (NIE128).
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Last day of the leave.
Days of leave in the period. Must reconcile to the PILA LMA change-event flag and its dates.
Amount paid. Advanced by the employer and recovered from the EPS.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Optional (0-1); pairs with 'Paid leave - end date' (NIE133).
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: First day of remunerated leave other than maternity or paternity (bereavement, marriage, voting, trade-union leave).

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Pairs with 'Paid leave - start date' (NIE132).
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Last day of the remunerated leave.
Days of remunerated leave. Maps to the PILA VAC-LR flag with value L.
Money value of the remunerated leave. Fully in the contribution base and the withholding base.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Optional (0-1); pairs with 'Unpaid leave - end date' (NIE137).
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: First day of unpaid leave or suspension. Maps to the PILA SLN change-event flag.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Pairs with 'Unpaid leave - start date' (NIE136).
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Last day of the unpaid leave.
Days of unpaid leave. NOTE: this block carries NO amount element - unpaid leave has no money value by definition. It still reduces DiasTrabajados (NIE069) and the contribution days.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Optional (0-1); pairs with 'Legal strike - end date' (NIE144).
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: First day of a lawful strike. Suspends the contract without terminating it.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Pairs with 'Legal strike - start date' (NIE143). NOTE the annex spells this attribute 'FechaFIn' with a capital I - reproduce it exactly or the document will not validate.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Last day of the strike. The attribute name is mis-cased in the official annex (FechaFIn); it must be emitted exactly as published.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.QueryRA: Confirm with the RA that XSD v1.0.6 still carries the mis-cased attribute name 'FechaFIn'.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Days of lawful strike. Like unpaid leave, this block carries no amount element.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.section: =========== ACCRUED - BONUSES, ALLOWANCES AND OTHER CONCEPTS (paired S / NS) ===========

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Paired salary / non-salary element. Populate S where the bonus is salary under CST art. 127; populate 'Bonus - non-salary' (NIE140) where the parties have agreed it is not salary under CST art. 128. Bidirectional pair: the S/NS split is a hard flag on the wage type set at configuration and must never be derived at reporting time.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Discretionary or contractual bonus that constitutes salary. Fully in the contribution base and in the withholding base.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Paired with 'Bonus - salary' (NIE139). Populate NS only where an express non-salary agreement exists under CST art. 128.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Non-salary bonus. Excluded from the contribution base, but counts toward the 40% non-salary clamp of Ley 1393 de 2010 art. 30 - the excess over 40% of total remuneration is added back into the contribution base.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Paired salary / non-salary element; pairs with 'Allowance - non-salary' (NIE142). The split is a configuration flag on the wage type.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Employer allowance that constitutes salary (for example a fixed, habitual connectivity or housing allowance not agreed as non-salary).
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Paired with 'Allowance - salary' (NIE141).
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Employer allowance expressly agreed as non-salary. Counts toward the 40% clamp.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Free-text label of a concept that has no dedicated element. Mandatory (1-1) inside the block: an amount without a description is not admissible.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Paired salary / non-salary element; pairs with 'Other concept - non-salary' (NIE148). At least one of the two must be present where 'Other concept - description' (NIE146) is populated.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Salary-constituting amount of the described concept.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Paired with 'Other concept - salary' (NIE147) and conditioned on 'Other concept - description' (NIE146).
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Non-salary amount of the described concept.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Applies only to worker type 31 (cooperados o precooperativas de trabajo asociado). Pairs with 'Extraordinary cooperative compensation' (NIE150).
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Ordinary compensation for associated cooperative work. Not an employment salary; reported here because worker type 31 is within the annex's TipoTrabajador list.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Applies only to worker type 31; pairs with 'Ordinary cooperative compensation' (NIE149).
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Extraordinary compensation for associated cooperative work.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Paired salary / non-salary element for payments made in electronic or paper service vouchers, cheques, cards or vales. Pairs with 'Voucher / card payment - non-salary' (NIE152).
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Salary-constituting portion of voucher, cheque, card or vale payments. Cross-report: this is the concept reported at Formulario 220 casilla 37 and Formato 2276 numeral 7.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Pairs with 'Voucher / card payment - salary' (NIE151).
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Non-salary portion of voucher or card payments.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Paired salary / non-salary element for third-party meal payments. Pairs with 'Meal payment - non-salary' (NIE154). The engine must ALSO maintain the ET art. 387-1 split at 41 UVT (COP 2,147,334 per month in 2026), because Formato 2276 reports the amount up to 41 UVT at numeral 32 and the EXCESS at numeral 8, in two different fields.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Salary-constituting meal payments made through a third party.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Pairs with 'Meal payment - salary' (NIE153). Under ET art. 387-1 the payment is NOT income to the worker up to 41 UVT per month where salary does not exceed 310 UVT (COP 16,235,940 in 2026); above either limit the excess is taxable.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Non-salary meal payments through a third party.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated where commission was paid in the period. Repeating (0-N).
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Sales or performance commission. ALWAYS salary in Colombia (CST art. 127) - it is not a paired S/NS element, which is the deliberate signal that it cannot be agreed as non-salary.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated where the employer paid a third party on the employee's behalf and it constitutes employee income. Distinct from NIE195, which is the DEDUCTION-side third-party element; do not confuse the two - they carry different NIE codes in different parents.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Payments made to third parties that are income of the employee. Repeating (0-N).
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated where an advance was paid in the period. Its recovery appears on the DEDUCTIONS side as NIE196 - the two are a bidirectional pair across the accrued and deducted blocks.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Salary advance paid to the employee. Repeating (0-N).
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated where work clothing was delivered in the period. Colombia mandates three annual deliveries - by 30 April, 31 August and 20 December (CST art. 232) - for employees earning up to 2 SMMLV.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Value of work clothing and footwear delivered. Never salary (CST art. 128) and never convertible into cash.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated only for apprentices - contract type 4 (NIE061) and worker type 12 or 19 (NIE041). Bidirectional: where NIE157 is present, NIE061 must be 4 and NIE041 must be 12 or 19.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Apoyo de sostenimiento paid to an apprentice. Ley 2466 de 2025 art. 21 recast the apprenticeship as a labour contract, so from 2026 the support is remuneration of an employee, not a training stipend, and is regulated by Decreto 0223 of 5 March 2026.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated for teleworkers and remote workers whose employer contributes to connectivity and energy costs under Ley 1221 de 2008 as amended by Ley 2466 de 2025 arts. 52-54.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Employer contribution toward the teleworker's connectivity and energy costs.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated on a termination document only. Typically co-occurs with 'Termination date' (NIE003) and with 'Indemnity' (NIE160).
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Ex gratia or negotiated bonus paid on departure. Fully taxable employment income; it enters the ordinary monthly withholding base.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated on a termination document only; co-occurs with 'Termination date' (NIE003).
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Indemnity for dismissal without just cause (CST art. 64). Fully taxable and enters the ordinary monthly base; only the statutory-minimum indemnities of ET art. 206 nums. 1-3 are exempt, and then only up to the legal minimum (art. 206 par. 1).
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated where an amount previously deducted is being returned to the employee. Distinct from the deduction-side Reintegro (NIE184); the two carry different codes and opposite signs.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Reimbursement returned to the employee - for example an over-deduction corrected in a later month.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.section: =========== DEDUCTIONS - MANDATORY SOCIAL SECURITY AND TAX ===========

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Employee health contribution rate: 4.00% of the contribution base (Ley 100 de 1993 art. 204 as amended). The employer's 8.5% is NOT an employee deduction and must never appear here.

Employee health deduction. FORMATTING TRAP: this is the XML figure at 2 decimals, round-half-to-even. The PILA figure for the same contribution is rounded UP to the next multiple of 100 and will legitimately differ by up to 99 pesos - the two must never be interchanged, and the payslip must show the XML figure.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Employee pension contribution rate: 4.00% of the contribution base, against the employer's 12.00%, for a total of 16% (Ley 100 de 1993 art. 20 as substituted by Ley 797 de 2003 art. 7). Set to 0.00 for an employed old-age pensioner (worker sub-type 01).
Employee pension deduction. Must NOT include the solidarity-fund surcharge, which has its own element (FondoSP, NIE167-NIE170) with four separate attributes.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Payable ONLY where the contribution base is at least 4 SMMLV (COP 7,003,620 in 2026). Bidirectional set of four: NIE167 pairs with 'Solidarity fund - solidarity amount' (NIE168), and the subsistence pair NIE169 / NIE170 has its own higher 16-SMMLV trigger.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Rate of the solidarity sub-account surcharge: 1.00% of the contribution base once the base reaches 4 SMMLV (Ley 100 art. 20 as substituted by Ley 797 de 2003 art. 7). Employee-only, and ADDITIONAL to the 4% pension.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Pairs with 'Solidarity fund - solidarity rate' (NIE167); present whenever the base is at least 4 SMMLV.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Money value of the solidarity sub-account surcharge. THE SINGLE MOST COMMON COLOMBIAN MAPPING ERROR is merging this into the pension line: the XML models the solidarity fund as FOUR distinct attributes and DIAN validates them separately.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Payable ONLY where the contribution base is at least 16 SMMLV (COP 28,014,480 in 2026) - a HIGHER trigger than the solidarity sub-account. Pairs with 'Solidarity fund - subsistence amount' (NIE170), and cannot be present unless NIE167 / NIE168 are also present.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Banded subsistence surcharge, 0.2% to 1.0%, rising by band from 16 SMMLV to above 20 SMMLV (Ley 797 de 2003 art. 7).

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Pairs with 'Solidarity fund - subsistence rate' (NIE169); present only from 16 SMMLV.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Money value of the subsistence sub-account surcharge. Reported separately from the solidarity amount; the two are never summed in the XML.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Present where withholding was applied. A depurated base in the 0% band of the ET art. 383 table produces no element rather than a zero. For a NON-RESIDENT this carries the flat 20% of ET art. 408 on the GROSS, with no depuration.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Retencion en la fuente sobre rentas de trabajo. RESIDENT: the ET art. 383 progressive table (0 / 19 / 28 / 33 / 35 / 37 / 39%) applied to the art. 388 depurated monthly base, under Procedure 1 or Procedure 2. NON-RESIDENT: the flat 20% of ET art. 408 on the gross payment, with no art. 388 depuration, no 25% exempt income, no art. 387 deductions and no tax-free band (DIAN Concepto 011108 of 29 June 2026). Cross-report: the sum of this element across all employees for the month must reconcile to Formulario 350 casilla 93.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole pesos, approximated to the nearest 1,000 per ET art. 868 par., then expressed with 2 decimals in the XML.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Present where the employee has authorised a voluntary pension contribution in writing.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Voluntary contribution to a pension fund. Reduces the withholding base within the ET art. 336 40% / 1,340 UVT annual limit. Cross-report: Formulario 220 casillas 55-56 and Formato 2276 numerals 25-26 split RAIS voluntary contributions from voluntary pension-fund contributions, so the engine must carry the two separately even though the XML has one element.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.QueryRA: Confirm how the client wants RAIS voluntary contributions (2276 numeral 25) distinguished from voluntary pension-fund contributions (numeral 26) when both map to NIE198.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Present where the employee has authorised a contribution to an AFC (Ahorro para el Fomento de la Construccion) account.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Long-term construction-savings contribution. Shares the ET art. 336 40% / 1,340 UVT cap with voluntary pension contributions. Cross-report: Formulario 220 casilla 57, Formato 2276 numeral 27.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Present only for a unionised employee. Pairs with 'Union dues - amount' (NIE172): both attributes are 1-1 inside the element, so where the element exists both must be populated.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Percentage rate of the union subscription, set by the union's statutes.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Pairs with 'Union dues' rate (NIE171); both are required where the Sindicato element is present.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Money value of the union subscription withheld. Requires the employee's written authorisation (CST art. 400).
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Present where a disciplinary sanction with a public destination is being withheld. Pairs with 'Private sanction' (NIE174) - both attributes are 1-1 inside the Sancion element.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Disciplinary fine whose proceeds go to a public destination. Colombian fines are capped by CST art. 113 and must be provided for in the internal work rules.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Pairs with 'Public sanction' (NIE173) inside the Sancion element.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Disciplinary fine retained by the employer's welfare fund.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Present where a libranza deduction is being made. Pairs with 'Payroll loan - amount' (NIE176): both attributes are 1-1 inside the element.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Description identifying the lender and the loan. Repeating (0-N) - an employee may carry several libranzas.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Pairs with 'Payroll loan - description' (NIE175).
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Instalment withheld under a libranza authorisation (Ley 1527 de 2012). ENGINE RULE: the aggregate of all libranza deductions must leave the employee at least 50% of net salary - a validation the XML does not perform.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Present where an amount is withheld and remitted to a third party. Distinct from NIE193, the ACCRUED-side third-party element - same element name, different NIE code and different parent.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Amounts withheld for payment to third parties. Repeating (0-N).
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Present where a previously paid advance is being recovered. Bidirectional pair with the accrued-side advance (NIE194) across the two blocks.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Recovery of a salary advance. Repeating (0-N).
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Present where a deduction has no dedicated element. Repeating (0-N).
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Catch-all deduction element. Use sparingly: DIAN expects concepts that have a dedicated element to use that element.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Present where the employee has authorised a deduction for a cooperative.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Contribution or repayment withheld for an employee cooperative.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Present where a court or tax authority has ordered an attachment of salary.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Attachment of salary. Colombian salary is unattachable up to the minimum wage, and only 20% of the excess is attachable, except for maintenance debts and cooperative debts (CST arts. 154-156) - an engine rule, not an XML rule.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Present where the employee has authorised a deduction for a complementary or prepaid health plan.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Prepaid or complementary health-plan premium withheld. Deductible from the withholding base under ET art. 387 up to 16 UVT per month.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Present where an education-related amount is withheld.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Education debt or contribution withheld from salary.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Present where the employee is repaying an amount to the employer. Distinct from the accrued-side Reintegro (NIE201).
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Repayment by the employee of an amount previously overpaid.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Present where a debt owed by the employee to the employer is being recovered.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Recovery of an employee debt. Requires written authorisation (CST art. 149).
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Present ONLY where the round-half-to-even rounding of the individual concepts produces a difference between the calculated total and the sum of the parts. Bidirectional with the three totals NIE187 / NIE188 / NIE189: where Redondeo is present, ComprobanteTotal must already incorporate it.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: The explicit residual carried so that the totals tie. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1 mandates round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401) and allows a validation tolerance of +/- 2.00; any residual within that tolerance must be disclosed here rather than absorbed silently into a concept.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Sum of every element in the Devengados block. Item 6 and item 8 of the art. 5 mandatory content. Input [4] to the CUNE, where it must be TRUNCATED to two decimals - truncated, not rounded, a distinction that catches many implementations.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Sum of every element in the Deducciones block. Item 7 of the art. 5 mandatory content. Input [5] to the CUNE, truncated to two decimals.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: DevengadosTotal minus DeduccionesTotal, adjusted for the Redondeo residual. Item 8 of the art. 5 mandatory content. Input [6] to the CUNE, truncated to two decimals.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Present (0-1) where the document reports a contractual change event. Bidirectional pair with 'Referenced CUNE' (NIE204): where Novedad is present, CUNENov is mandatory (1-1) inside it.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Set to the literal true or false. Signals that this document reports a change to a previously transmitted document's contractual data (Anexo Tecnico s.11).

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Mandatory (1-1) whenever the 'Contractual change flag' (NIE199) element is present; must be absent otherwise. Bidirectional pair with NIE199.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: The CUNE of the document to which the contractual change relates. Establishes the cross-reference chain between documents for the same employment relationship.

Annex table 5.5.8: 1 Reemplazar (replace, for arithmetic, accounting or content errors) and 2 Eliminar (cancel a document transmitted in error). NOTE the annex's own caveat: code 2 only INVALIDATES the erroneous document - it does not by itself restore the position, so a corrected document must follow.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.OptionValues: -> Sheet 6: Tipo de Nota de Ajuste (table 5.5.8)

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: The Reemplazar block is present when 'Adjustment note type' (NIAE214) = 1, and absent when it = 2. Mutually exclusive with the Eliminar block. Bidirectional pair with NIAE214.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Where the note replaces a document, the Reemplazar block repeats the ENTIRE NominaIndividual structure with corrected values, under NIAE-prefixed codes that mirror the NIE codes one for one (NIAE023 = Ambiente, NIAE044 = TipoDocumento, NIAE187 = DevengadosTotal, and so on). It carries its OWN CUNE, computed on the same eleven inputs from the Reemplazar block.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: The Eliminar block is present when 'Adjustment note type' (NIAE214) = 2, and absent when it = 1. Mutually exclusive with the Reemplazar block.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.SysMap: (references the original document by its CUNE)
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Cancellation block. Its CUNE is computed with ValDev, ValDed and ValTol FORCED TO 0.00 and DocEmp forced to 0 (Anexo Tecnico s.8.1.1.4) - a deliberate divergence from the replace case that a naive shared CUNE routine will get wrong.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: 2 decimals, round-half-to-even (NTC 3711 / JIS Z 8401); DIAN validation tolerance +/- 2.00; any residual is carried by the Redondeo element NIE186. Anexo Tecnico s.1.1.1.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Synchronous SOAP response returned in the same call as SendNominaSync. THIS IS A HARD INBOUND DEPENDENCY, not a receipt: a payroll cost is tax-deductible only where the supporting document has been validated, so the engine must parse and persist the outcome.

The validation verdict, base64-encoded inside the SOAP response. Decode it, read the acceptance or rejection, and store the raw payload for audit - it is the employer's evidence that the document exists in DIAN's system.

Derived acceptance status. Store per document per employee per period. A rejection must trigger correction and re-transmission; an unvalidated document must block the tax deduction of the corresponding payroll cost in the client's ledger.

CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Present only where 'Validation status' (INB-03) is a rejection. Bidirectional pair with INB-03: a rejection status without rule codes is an incomplete parse.
CO-DIAN-001-NominaElectronica-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: The validation rules breached, from Anexo Tecnico s.6.1. The frequent ones are NIE022 (wrong Version literal), rule 90 (document number already used for that employee) and rule 92 (issuer not enabled). Persist them: they drive the correction path.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Calendar year of the period being declared. The form is prescribed for periods from 1 August 2024 onward (Res. DIAN 000031 de 2024 art. 3).
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Calendar month being declared, 01 to 12. Formulario 350 is a MONTHLY return; there is no quarterly or annual variant for withholding agents.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Assigned by the DIAN electronic filing service, not by the declarant - the form prints 'Espacio reservado para la DIAN' against it. It becomes the reference quoted in casilla 26 of any later corrective return.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Tax identification number of the withholding agent, taken from casilla 5 of the RUT. The last digit of this number determines the filing deadline (7th to 16th business day of the following month). Join key to the nomina electronica (NIE033) and to PILA.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: DIAN check digit of the NIT, from casilla 6 of the RUT.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated only where the withholding agent is a NATURAL person. Mutually exclusive with 'Corporate name' (casilla 11): a legal person populates 11 and leaves 7 to 10 blank, and a natural person does the reverse.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: First surname of a natural-person withholding agent, from casilla 31 of the RUT. Auto-filled by the DIAN service from the RUT.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated only for a natural-person withholding agent. Mutually exclusive with 'Corporate name' (casilla 11).
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Second surname of a natural-person withholding agent, from casilla 32 of the RUT.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated only for a natural-person withholding agent. Mutually exclusive with 'Corporate name' (casilla 11).
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: First given name of a natural-person withholding agent, from casilla 33 of the RUT.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated only for a natural-person withholding agent. Mutually exclusive with 'Corporate name' (casilla 11).
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Remaining given names of a natural-person withholding agent, from casilla 34 of the RUT.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated only where the withholding agent is a LEGAL person. Mutually exclusive with the natural-person name casillas 7, 8, 9 and 10.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Corporate name, auto-filled by the DIAN service from casilla 35 of the RUT. The instructivo says expressly that it 'se diligencia automaticamente' - do not attempt to override it.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Code of the DIAN sectional office of the taxpayer's principal domicile, from casilla 12 of the RUT. A configuration attribute of the entity, not a period value.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated ONLY where this return corrects an earlier one. Bidirectional pair with 'Previous form number' (casilla 26): where 25 is populated 26 must be populated, and vice versa. Both blank on an initial return.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Set by the DIAN service: 1 = correction of the taxpayer's own return; 2 = correction of a DIAN-generated correction under Ley 962 de 2005 art. 43; 3 = correction prompted by an administrative act.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated ONLY on a corrective return. Bidirectional pair with 'Correction code' (casilla 25). Carries the casilla-4 number of the return being corrected.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: The casilla 4 form number of the return, or of the administrative act, being corrected. This is the link that lets DIAN supersede the earlier filing rather than treat this one as a duplicate.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.EN: Self-withholding activity code (art. 114-1 exonerated legal persons)
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.ES: Autorretenedores Personas Juridicas exonerados de aportes (Art. 114-1 E.T.) - Actividad economica principal
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Fillable EXCLUSIVELY by legal persons that are exonerated from employer contributions under ET art. 114-1. Bidirectional pair with 'Self-withholding rate' (casilla 28), which the DIAN service derives automatically once 27 is chosen.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Principal economic-activity code from casilla 46 of the RUT, chosen from the codes in DIAN Resoluciones 000114 of 21 December 2020, 001232 of 16 September 2022 and 000086 of 24 May 2023. THE SAME ART. 114-1 EXONERATION that drives this casilla also drives PILA archivo tipo 1 field 33 and Registro Tipo 2 field 76 - the employer that is exonerated from employer health, SENA and ICBF for employees under 10 SMMLV is the employer that self-withholds here.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Derived automatically by the DIAN service from 'Self-withholding activity code' (casilla 27); cannot be keyed independently. Bidirectional pair with casilla 27.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: The self-withholding rate for the chosen activity, applied to ALL payments received. Set by DUR 1625 de 2016 art. 1.2.6.8. Not a payroll figure - it applies to the employer's own income, not to its employees.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Rate as printed by the DIAN service.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.section: =========== PAYROLL WITHHOLDING - THE TWO CASILLAS THAT PAYROLL OWNS (hoja 1, 77 and 93) ===========

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.ES: Rentas de trabajo - base sujeta a retencion
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: THE PRINCIPAL PAYROLL CASILLA ON THE BASE SIDE. The instructivo defines it as 'los pagos gravables (base sujeta a retencion) efectuados a personas naturales por concepto de salarios, comisiones, prestaciones sociales, viaticos, gastos de representacion, honorarios, emolumentos eclesiasticos, compensaciones recibidas por el trabajo asociado cooperativo, pagos en especie, pagos en acciones y, en general, las compensaciones por servicios personales'. NOTE that it is the DEPURATED taxable base, not the gross: for a resident it is the ET art. 388 base after non-constitutive income, art. 387 deductions and the 25% exempt income; for a NON-RESIDENT taxed under art. 408 the base is the GROSS, because art. 408 admits no depuration. Note also that it sweeps in honorarios paid to natural persons under the art. 383 table, which are not employment income - payroll supplies only the employment component.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.ES: Rentas de trabajo - retenciones a titulo de renta
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: THE PRINCIPAL PAYROLL CASILLA ON THE WITHHOLDING SIDE. The month's total retencion en la fuente on work income paid to natural persons. Must reconcile to the sum of RetencionFuente (NIE177) across every nomina electronica document for the same month, after the nearest-1,000 rounding. It is one of the forty-two casillas summed into casilla 130.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.ES: Rentas de pensiones - base sujeta a retencion
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated only where the EMPLOYER itself pays a pension. Bidirectional pair with 'Withholding - pension income' (casilla 94): a base without a withholding, or the reverse, is an inconsistency. Blank for an ordinary corporate payroll, where pensions are paid by a fund.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: The monthly pension payment EXCEEDING 1,000 UVT (COP 52,374,000 in 2026) under ET art. 206 num. 5, for retirement, invalidity, old-age, survivor and occupational-risk pensions and for substitute indemnities and returns of pension savings. Only the excess over 1,000 UVT is taxable, so the casilla is nil for the overwhelming majority of pensions.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated only where the employer pays a pension. Bidirectional pair with 'Base - pension income' (casilla 78).
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Withholding on the taxable excess of employer-paid pension income. Summed into casilla 130.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.section: =========== NON-RESIDENT PAYMENTS ABROAD - hoja 1 summary casillas (v2.8 control B1) ===========

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.EN: Base - payments abroad, no treaty (legal persons)
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.ES: Pagos o abonos en cuenta al exterior a paises sin convenio - base

Bidirectional pair with 'Withholding - payments abroad, no treaty (legal persons)' (casilla 57) and with hoja 2 total casilla 148.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Base of payments to foreign ENTITIES without a Colombian domicile, in countries with no double-tax treaty. Not a payroll casilla - a foreign entity is not an employee - but shown here because it shares the hoja 2 annex with the non-resident EMPLOYEE casillas.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.EN: Withholding - payments abroad, no treaty (legal persons)

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Withholding on payments to foreign entities in non-treaty countries. Summed into casilla 130.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.ES: Pagos o abonos en cuenta al exterior a paises con convenio vigente - base

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Base of payments to foreign entities in countries with a double-tax treaty in force.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.ES: Pagos o abonos en cuenta al exterior a paises con convenio vigente - retenciones
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Auto-derived from hoja 2 total casilla 154. Bidirectional pair with casilla 56.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Withholding on payments to foreign entities in treaty countries.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.EN: Base - payments abroad, no treaty (NATURAL persons)
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.ES: Pagos o abonos en cuenta al exterior a paises sin convenio - base - personas naturales
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: THE NON-RESIDENT EMPLOYEE BASE CASILLA where the employee's country has no treaty. Auto-derived by the DIAN service from hoja 2 total casilla 149 - the sum of casilla 145 where casilla 141 = SIN CONVENIO and casilla 143 = Persona natural. Bidirectional pair with 'Withholding - payments abroad, no treaty (natural persons)' (casilla 111).
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Gross payments to non-resident natural persons in non-treaty countries. For an employee this is the GROSS salary - ET art. 408 admits no depuration - reported through hoja 2 concepto de pago 5, 'Prestaciones de servicios y compensacion por servicios personales'.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.EN: Withholding - payments abroad, no treaty (NATURAL persons)
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.ES: Pagos o abonos en cuenta al exterior a paises sin convenio - retenciones - personas naturales
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Auto-derived from hoja 2 total casilla 151. Bidirectional pair with casilla 109.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Withholding on those payments - the flat 20% of ET art. 408 for employment income. Summed into casilla 130.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.ES: Pagos o abonos en cuenta al exterior a paises con convenio vigente - base - personas naturales
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: THE NON-RESIDENT EMPLOYEE BASE CASILLA where a double-tax treaty applies. Auto-derived from hoja 2 total casilla 153. Bidirectional pair with 'Withholding - payments abroad, treaty (natural persons)' (casilla 112).
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Gross payments to non-resident natural persons in treaty countries, reported through hoja 2 concepto de pago 24, 'Rentas de trabajo' - the concept whose own definition is 'rentas de trabajo de cualquier naturaleza en relacion con un empleo a favor de personas naturales no residentes'. This is the exact place a non-resident EMPLOYEE with treaty cover is reported.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.ES: Pagos o abonos en cuenta al exterior a paises con convenio vigente - retenciones - personas naturales
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Auto-derived from hoja 2 total casilla 155. Bidirectional pair with casilla 110.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Withholding after treaty relief. Where the treaty assigns taxing rights to the residence state the rate may be reduced to nil. Mercans applies treaty relief ONLY on written client instruction supported by a residence certificate.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.ES: A paises con o sin convenio
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: One row per payment concept, country and person type. Drives which concepto list applies in casilla 142 and which of the four totals (148, 149, 152, 153) the row feeds. Bidirectional with casilla 142 and casilla 143.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Drop-down: SIN CONVENIO or CON CONVENIO. Choosing CON CONVENIO switches casilla 142 to the treaty concept list (19 to 33) and requires the applicable double-tax treaty to be consulted for the rate.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: The list offered depends on 'Treaty status' (casilla 141): concepts 1-18 for SIN CONVENIO, 19-33 for CON CONVENIO. Bidirectional pair with casilla 141.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: For a NON-RESIDENT EMPLOYEE the two relevant concepts are: SIN CONVENIO concepto 5, 'Prestaciones de servicios y compensacion por servicios personales'; CON CONVENIO concepto 24, 'Rentas de trabajo' - expressly 'rentas de trabajo de cualquier naturaleza en relacion con un empleo'. Concepto 25 covers directors' fees and concepto 27 pensions. NOTE the documentation conflict recorded in the RA query column.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.QueryRA: SOURCE CONFLICT, escalate. Res. DIAN 000227 de 2025 art. 1.2.2.26 par. 3 refers to 'la Casilla 91 - Concepto de pago de la hoja dos' and to options '01. Enajenacion de activos fijos y otras retenciones' and '14. Otras rentas'. On the currently prescribed form the hoja-2 concepto de pago is CASILLA 142, and its option 14 is 'Servicios de transporte internacional' - option 1 is 'Intereses'. The compilation resolution appears to cite a superseded form. Confirm the correct casilla and option codes for reporting significant economic presence (ET art. 20-3) with the RA.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Determines whether the row feeds the legal-person totals (148 / 150 / 152 / 154) or the natural-person totals (149 / 151 / 153 / 155). Bidirectional with casillas 141 and 142. This column is NEW in the 2024 form.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Persona juridica or Persona natural. A non-resident EMPLOYEE is always Persona natural; this is the field that separates employee withholding from supplier withholding in the annex.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Required on every annex row. Where 'Treaty status' (casilla 141) = CON CONVENIO the country must be one with a treaty in force.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Country receiving the payment, with its country code. Colombia's treaty network in force includes Spain, Chile, Switzerland, Canada, Mexico, South Korea, Portugal, India, the Czech Republic, the United Kingdom, France, Italy and Japan, plus Andean Community Decision 578.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Required on every annex row. Together with 'Rate' (casilla 146) it produces 'Withholding value' (casilla 147) automatically.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: GROSS amount paid or credited to the non-resident. For an employee this is the whole salary - ET art. 408 taxes the gross, with no deduction of the mandatory social-security contributions.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Required on every annex row. Determined by ET art. 408 for non-treaty payments, or by the applicable treaty article for treaty payments. Bidirectional pair with casilla 141: the treaty status determines which rate source applies.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: 20% is the general ET art. 408 rate for employment income and personal services. Special rates in the instructivo include 15% for long-term foreign credits, 5% for international transport and for APP-financing interest, 33% for head-office management charges, 1% for aircraft leasing and reinsurance premiums, and 7% for foreign professors on contracts of up to four months.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Rate as a percentage.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Computed automatically by the DIAN service as casilla 145 x casilla 146. Not keyed. Bidirectional with casillas 145 and 146.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: The instructivo states expressly that 'el SI de Diligenciamiento calcula automaticamente los valores de las retenciones multiplicando el valor registrado en la casilla 145 por la tarifa registrada en la casilla 146'. Payroll supplies 145 and 146; it must NOT attempt to key 147.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.ES: Pagos al exterior paises sin convenio persona juridica
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Auto-summed where casilla 141 = SIN CONVENIO and casilla 143 = Persona juridica. Feeds hoja 1 casilla 55.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Sum of casilla 145 across the matching annex rows. Carried up to hoja 1 casilla 55.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.EN: Total base - no treaty, natural persons
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.ES: Pagos al exterior paises sin convenio persona natural
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Auto-summed where casilla 141 = SIN CONVENIO and casilla 143 = Persona natural. Feeds hoja 1 casilla 109.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Sum of casilla 145 across the matching annex rows. This is where a non-resident employee in a non-treaty country lands. Carried up to hoja 1 casilla 109.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.EN: Total withholding - no treaty, legal persons
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.ES: Valor retencion sin convenio persona juridica
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Auto-summed; feeds hoja 1 casilla 57.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Sum of casilla 147 across the matching annex rows.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.EN: Total withholding - no treaty, natural persons
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.ES: Valor retencion sin convenio persona natural
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Auto-summed; feeds hoja 1 casilla 111.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Sum of casilla 147 across the matching annex rows - the non-resident employee withholding in non-treaty countries.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.ES: Pagos al exterior paises con convenio persona juridica
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Auto-summed; feeds hoja 1 casilla 56.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Sum of casilla 145 across the matching annex rows.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.ES: Pagos al exterior paises con convenio persona natural
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Auto-summed; feeds hoja 1 casilla 110.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Sum of casilla 145 across the matching annex rows - where a non-resident employee covered by a treaty lands, under concepto de pago 24.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.ES: Valor retencion con convenio persona juridica
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Auto-summed; feeds hoja 1 casilla 58.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Sum of casilla 147 across the matching annex rows.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.
