CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.section: =========== NON-PAYROLL WITHHOLDING CONCEPTS - NOT PRODUCED BY PAYROLL ===========

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.EN: Bases and withholdings on legal persons
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.ES: Bases y retenciones a personas juridicas
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated by the client's accounts-payable function where the corresponding payment was made. Payroll contributes nothing.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Fourteen concept pairs for payments to legal persons - honorarios (29 / 42), comisiones (30 / 43), servicios (31 / 44), rendimientos financieros (32 / 45), arrendamientos (33 / 46), regalias (34 / 47), dividendos (35 / 48), compras (36 / 49), tarjetas (37 / 50), contratos de construccion (38 / 51), loterias (39 / 52), hidrocarburos (40 / 53) and otros pagos (41 / 54). Not produced by payroll. Present on the form because Formulario 350 aggregates EVERY withholding the employer makes, not only payroll withholding. Populated by the client's accounts-payable or tax function; payroll contributes nothing to this casilla.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.EN: Bases and withholdings on natural persons, non-employment concepts
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.ES: Bases y retenciones a personas naturales - conceptos no laborales
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated by accounts payable. Payroll contributes only casillas 77 / 93 and, where applicable, 78 / 94.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: The same concept grid repeated for natural persons - honorarios (79 / 95), comisiones (80 / 96), servicios (81 / 97), and so on to otros pagos (92 / 108), plus enajenacion de activos fijos (89 / 105) which exists only in the natural-person column. Honorarios paid to a natural person under the art. 383 table can straddle 77 / 93 and 79 / 95; the boundary is a client decision, documented in the Population Rules. Not produced by payroll. Present on the form because Formulario 350 aggregates EVERY withholding the employer makes, not only payroll withholding. Populated by the client's accounts-payable or tax function; payroll contributes nothing to this casilla.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated where the employer is an authorised self-withholding agent. Casilla 59 / 68 is the art. 114-1 self-withholding driven by casillas 27 and 28.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Self-withholding on the employer's OWN income - ventas, honorarios, comisiones, servicios, rendimientos financieros, mining exports and otros conceptos, for legal persons (59-76) and natural persons (113-128). Not produced by payroll. Present on the form because Formulario 350 aggregates EVERY withholding the employer makes, not only payroll withholding. Populated by the client's accounts-payable or tax function; payroll contributes nothing to this casilla.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated by the client's tax function. Casilla 132 is the withholding on services supplied by non-residents or non-domiciled persons.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: 131 VAT withheld from VAT-responsible suppliers; 132 VAT withheld on services from non-residents; 133 excess or undue VAT withholding reversed; 134 total VAT withholding (131 + 132 - 133); 135 national stamp-duty withholding. Not produced by payroll. Present on the form because Formulario 350 aggregates EVERY withholding the employer makes, not only payroll withholding. Populated by the client's accounts-payable or tax function; payroll contributes nothing to this casilla.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.ES: Menos retenciones practicadas en exceso o indebidas
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated where withholding was practised in excess or in error, or on transactions annulled, rescinded or resolved. Subtracted in casilla 130.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Amounts over-withheld or wrongly withheld, and reversals of withholding on cancelled transactions. Where the month's withholding is insufficient to absorb the credit, the instructivo permits carrying it to the immediately following periods. Payroll DOES feed this casilla where an employee's withholding is corrected downward in a later month.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.
Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Casilla 130 (income tax) plus casilla 134 (VAT) plus casilla 135 (stamp duty).
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated where a penalty arises on this filing - late filing or correction. Feeds casilla 138.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Total penalties arising from this return. The instructivo warns that the penalty declared cannot be less than the minimum penalty of 10 UVT (COP 523,740 in 2026) for late filing, and that for a corrective return the minimum is 10 UVT of the year in which the ORIGINAL return was filed.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Casilla 136 plus casilla 137. This is the amount that must be PAID IN FULL: a withholding return filed without full payment produces NO legal effect, with no administrative act needed to say so (ET art. 580-1, quoted in the instructivo).
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: NIT assigned by DIAN to the person signing the return - the legal representative or an authorised agent.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Verification digit of the signatory's NIT.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: The amount actually paid with the return. Reserved-range casilla. Must equal casilla 138 for the return to have legal effect.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole pesos, then rounded to the nearest 1,000 (ET art. 577) - applies to every money casilla of the return.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Type of representation of the person signing for the declarant, taken from casilla 98 of the RUT.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated where the return must be signed by an accountant or a statutory auditor. Bidirectional set with 'Professional card number' (casilla 983) and 'With qualifications' (casilla 994): where 982 is populated, 983 is mandatory and 994 becomes available.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: 1 = Contador, 2 = Revisor fiscal. The instructivo sets the thresholds: an accountant must sign where the taxpayer keeps books and gross assets at the preceding year end exceeded 100,000 UVT; a statutory auditor must sign for joint-stock companies, for companies whose gross assets reach 5,000 SMMLV, and for companies whose gross income reaches 3,000 SMMLV.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Mandatory where 'Accountant or statutory auditor code' (casilla 982) is populated; blank otherwise. Bidirectional pair with casilla 982.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Professional card number issued by the Junta Central de Contadores.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Available only where 'Accountant or statutory auditor code' (casilla 982) is populated. Bidirectional pair with casilla 982.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Marked with an x where the accountant or statutory auditor signs with qualifications.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.ES: Espacio exclusivo para el sello de la entidad recaudadora
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: DISPLAY-ONLY. Reserved for the collecting bank's stamp on a paper receipt. It is not a data field, is not keyed and is not transmitted; it exists on the printed representation only.
CO-DIAN-002-Formulario350-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Format: N
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: SHARP CONTRAST WITH FORMULARIO 350. The instructivo says this number is 'asignado por la persona natural o juridica que expide la certificacion' - the EMPLOYER assigns it, not DIAN. On Form 350 casilla 4 is DIAN-assigned. The engine must therefore maintain its own certificate numbering series and keep it stable, because the employee quotes it.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Format: N (no dots, no hyphens, no DV)
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: NIT of the withholding agent as it appears in casilla 5 of the RUT, WITHOUT the verification digit. The instructivo is emphatic: 'En ningun caso escriba puntos, guiones o letras'.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Format: N
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Verification digit as it appears in casilla 6 of the RUT.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated only where the withholding agent is a NATURAL person. Mutually exclusive with 'Corporate name' (casilla 11), which the instructivo says a natural person must NOT fill.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Format: A
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: First surname of a natural-person agent, matching casilla 31 of the RUT. The instructivo directs that where it does not match, THE RUT MUST BE UPDATED BEFORE THE CERTIFICATE IS ISSUED - the form does not override the register.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated only for a natural-person agent. Mutually exclusive with 'Corporate name' (casilla 11).
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Format: A
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Second surname, matching casilla 32 of the RUT.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated only for a natural-person agent. Mutually exclusive with 'Corporate name' (casilla 11).
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Format: A
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: First given name, matching casilla 33 of the RUT.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated only for a natural-person agent. Mutually exclusive with 'Corporate name' (casilla 11).
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Format: A
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Remaining given names, matching casilla 34 of the RUT.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated only where the withholding agent is a LEGAL person or a sociedad de hecho. The instructivo states that a natural-person issuer 'no debe diligenciar esta casilla'. Mutually exclusive with casillas 7 to 10.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Format: A
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Full corporate name, matching casilla 35 of the RUT.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Format: N (code)
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: The instructivo prints a SIX-VALUE list on the form itself: 12 Tarjeta de identidad, 13 Cedula de ciudadania, 21 Tarjeta de extranjeria, 22 Cedula de extranjeria, 31 NIT, 41 Pasaporte. That is NARROWER than the nomina electronica list at Anexo table 5.2.1, which also carries 11 Registro civil, 42 Documento de identificacion extranjero, 47 PEP, 50 NIT de otro pais and 91 NUIP. An employee holding a PEP or a PPT therefore has NO exact code here.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.QueryRA: The Form 220 document-type list omits 47 (PEP) and has no PPT code at all. Confirm with the RA how a PEP or PPT holder should be certified - 41 (Pasaporte) and 22 (Cedula de extranjeria) are the only near neighbours and neither is correct.

CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Format: N / AN
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Identification number exactly as it appears on the identity document. Join key to the nomina electronica NIE045, to PILA Registro Tipo 2 campo 4 and to Formato 2276 numeral 2.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Format: A
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: First surname exactly as on the identity document.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Format: A
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Second surname. Not mandatory here, in contrast with the nomina electronica where it is use=required (CO-GAP-07).
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Format: A
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: First given name exactly as on the identity document.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Format: A
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Remaining given names.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Format: AAAA MM DD
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: First day of the certified period. Normally 1 January, but the hire date where the employee joined during the year. Bidirectional pair with casilla 31.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Format: AAAA MM DD
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Last day of the certified period. Normally 31 December, but the termination date where the employee left during the year. Bidirectional pair with casilla 30.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Format: AAAA MM DD
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Date the certificate is issued, in year-month-day order. Must be on or before the LAST BUSINESS DAY OF MARCH following the fiscal year - the statutory deadline.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.EN: Place where the withholding was made
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.ES: Lugar donde se practico la retencion
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Format: A
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: City or municipality where the withholding was practised - not necessarily the employer's registered domicile, and not necessarily the employee's place of work.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Format: N (DANE)
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: DANE department code of the place in casilla 33. The instructivo directs the use of the DANE 'Codigo de departamentos' tables.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Format: N (DANE)
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: DANE municipality code of the place in casilla 33. Like PILA and unlike the nomina electronica, Form 220 splits the DIVIPOLA code across two casillas.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Format: N (whole pesos, nearest 1,000; zero where nil)
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Total salary payments ACTUALLY MADE in the period to a resident natural person whose income derives from an employment or statutory relationship. The instructivo quotes CST art. 127 in full: salary is not only the ordinary fixed or variable remuneration but everything the employee receives in money or in kind as direct consideration for the service - primas, sobresueldos, habitual bonuses, overtime, work on mandatory rest days, sales percentages and commissions. EXCLUSION RULE: do NOT include here any value belonging in casillas 38 to 46.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole Colombian pesos, approximated to the NEAREST 1,000, exactly as the instructivo directs. Where a casilla has no value, write ZERO - do not leave it blank.

CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.EN: Payments made with vouchers, cheques, cards or vales
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.ES: Pagos realizados con bonos electronicos o de papel de servicio, cheques, tarjetas, vales, etc.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Format: N (whole pesos, nearest 1,000; zero where nil)
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Payments made in electronic or paper service vouchers, cheques, cards or vales - for fuel, school supplies, footwear and clothing, or any other purpose. Deductible for the employer and income for the employee. THREE EXPLICIT NOTES in the instructivo: (1) INCLUDE meal payments for an employee earning MORE than 310 UVT per month; (2) do NOT include meal payments for an employee earning up to 310 UVT - those go to casilla 38; (3) do NOT include anything already reported in casilla 36.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole Colombian pesos, approximated to the NEAREST 1,000, exactly as the instructivo directs. Where a casilla has no value, write ZERO - do not leave it blank.

CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.EN: Excess meal payments over 41 UVT (ET art. 387-1)
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.ES: Valor del exceso de los pagos por alimentacion mayores a 41 UVT, art. 387-1 E.T.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated only where meal payments to a third party exceed 41 UVT in a month AND the employee's salary does not exceed 310 UVT. Bidirectional pair with casilla 37: where the salary exceeds 310 UVT the WHOLE meal payment goes to casilla 37 instead, and casilla 38 stays nil.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Format: N (whole pesos, nearest 1,000; zero where nil)
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Where the employer pays a THIRD PARTY for the employee's or their family's meals - a restaurant, own or third-party, or vouchers for food - the payment is deductible for the employer and is NOT income for the employee but for the supplier, PROVIDED the employee's salary does not exceed 310 UVT (COP 16,235,940 per month in 2026). Where the monthly payments exceed 41 UVT (COP 2,147,334 in 2026), THE EXCESS is taxable income of the employee and is withheld as employment income. The instructivo adds that the rule does not apply to company representation expenses, which remain deductible. Do NOT include amounts already in casilla 36.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole Colombian pesos, approximated to the NEAREST 1,000, exactly as the instructivo directs. Where a casilla has no value, write ZERO - do not leave it blank.

CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated only where the employer paid fees to this natural person. Not employment income; present because Form 220 certifies all work income of ET art. 383, not only employment income.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Format: N (whole pesos, nearest 1,000; zero where nil)
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Fees paid to natural persons providing services in which the INTELLECTUAL factor predominates over the technical, material, manual or mechanical - typically a professional qualification or substantial expertise in a field. The instructivo also directs that ECCLESIASTICAL EMOLUMENTS be included here, in money or in kind, direct or indirect, whatever the denomination and whatever the religious orientation.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole Colombian pesos, approximated to the NEAREST 1,000, exactly as the instructivo directs. Where a casilla has no value, write ZERO - do not leave it blank.

CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated only where the employer paid such services to this natural person.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Format: N (whole pesos, nearest 1,000; zero where nil)
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Payments for services - any activity, labour or work performed WITHOUT an employment relationship, resulting in an obligation to do, in which the technical and manual predominate over the intellectual.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole Colombian pesos, approximated to the NEAREST 1,000, exactly as the instructivo directs. Where a casilla has no value, write ZERO - do not leave it blank.

CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated only where the employer paid non-employment commissions to this natural person. Mutually exclusive with casilla 36 for the same amount.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Format: N (whole pesos, nearest 1,000; zero where nil)
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Commissions - remuneration for acts, operations, dealings, mandates, business or sales carried out in one's own name but for the account of another, whether or not commercial. NOTE: commissions paid UNDER AN EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT are salary under CST art. 127 and belong in casilla 36; this casilla is for non-employment commissions.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole Colombian pesos, approximated to the NEAREST 1,000, exactly as the instructivo directs. Where a casilla has no value, write ZERO - do not leave it blank.

CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Format: N (whole pesos, nearest 1,000; zero where nil)
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Statutory benefits OTHER THAN severance savings and the interest on them. The instructivo lists prima de servicios, vacaciones and dotaciones among them, and directs expressly that severance savings paid to the employee go to casilla 47 and severance savings deposited to the fund go elsewhere. RECORDED DEFECT: the instructivo for THIS casilla says the deposited severance goes to 'la casilla 48', but the form's own printed label makes casilla 48 the TRADITIONAL-REGIME severance and casilla 49 the amount deposited to the fund. The form layout is authoritative.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole Colombian pesos, approximated to the NEAREST 1,000, exactly as the instructivo directs. Where a casilla has no value, write ZERO - do not leave it blank.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.QueryRA: DEFECT IN THE OFFICIAL INSTRUCTIVO, recorded. The casilla-42 instruction cross-refers severance deposited to the fund to 'casilla 48'; the form's printed label puts it at casilla 49, and casilla 48 is the traditional-regime severance. Confirm with the RA that the form layout governs.

CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated where per diems were paid in the period. Related to the nomina electronica paired elements NIE072 / NIE073, which split the same amount by salary character.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Format: N (whole pesos, nearest 1,000; zero where nil)
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Per diems paid to cover transport, subsistence and accommodation while the employee works away from the habitual place of work. The instructivo cites Ministerio del Trabajo Concepto 23959 of 13 February. Note the split that matters elsewhere: the PERMANENT portion is salary under CST art. 130 and feeds the contribution base, while the accidental portion does not - the nomina electronica carries them as the paired ViaticoManuAlojS / NS elements.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole Colombian pesos, approximated to the NEAREST 1,000, exactly as the instructivo directs. Where a casilla has no value, write ZERO - do not leave it blank.

CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated where representation expenses were paid in the period.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Format: N (whole pesos, nearest 1,000; zero where nil)
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Representation expenses paid to the employee. The instructivo notes at casilla 38 that company representation expenses are deductible for the company and fall outside the meal-payment rule of ET art. 387-1.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole Colombian pesos, approximated to the NEAREST 1,000, exactly as the instructivo directs. Where a casilla has no value, write ZERO - do not leave it blank.

CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.ES: Pagos por compensaciones por el trabajo asociado cooperativo
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated only for a member of an associated-work cooperative - PILA contributor type 31 and nomina electronica TipoTrabajador 31.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Format: N (whole pesos, nearest 1,000; zero where nil)
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Compensation for associated cooperative work. Corresponds to the nomina electronica Compensacion elements (NIE149 / NIE150) and applies only to worker type 31.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole Colombian pesos, approximated to the NEAREST 1,000, exactly as the instructivo directs. Where a casilla has no value, write ZERO - do not leave it blank.

CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated where a work-income payment has no dedicated casilla.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Format: N (whole pesos, nearest 1,000; zero where nil)
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Work-income payments not falling in any other casilla. Use sparingly: DIAN expects a concept with a dedicated casilla to use that casilla.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole Colombian pesos, approximated to the NEAREST 1,000, exactly as the instructivo directs. Where a casilla has no value, write ZERO - do not leave it blank.

CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.EN: Severance savings and interest paid to the employee
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.ES: Auxilio de cesantia e intereses efectivamente pagados al empleado
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Format: N (whole pesos, nearest 1,000; zero where nil)
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: THE FIRST OF THREE SEVERANCE LINES. Severance savings and the interest on them ACTUALLY PAID to the employee in the period - typically the January interest payment and any authorised partial withdrawal or termination settlement. Excluded from the monthly withholding base under ET art. 206 num. 4 but still certified here.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.OptionValues: -> Sheet 6: Las tres lineas de cesantias
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole Colombian pesos, approximated to the NEAREST 1,000, exactly as the instructivo directs. Where a casilla has no value, write ZERO - do not leave it blank.

CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.EN: Severance savings under the traditional CST regime
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.ES: Auxilio de cesantia reconocido a trabajadores del regimen tradicional del Codigo Sustantivo del Trabajo, contenido en el Capitulo VII, Titulo VIII Parte Primera
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated only for an employee under the pre-1991 traditional severance regime. Mutually exclusive with 'Severance savings deposited to the fund' (casilla 49) for the same employee: a traditional-regime employee has no annual fund deposit.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Format: N (whole pesos, nearest 1,000; zero where nil)
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: THE SECOND OF THREE SEVERANCE LINES. Severance RECOGNISED - not necessarily paid - to employees remaining under the pre-1991 retroactive regime of CST Chapter VII, Title VIII, Part One, rather than the Ley 50 de 1990 annual-deposit regime. A shrinking but real population: employees hired before 1 January 1991 who did not elect the new regime.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.OptionValues: -> Sheet 6: Las tres lineas de cesantias
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole Colombian pesos, approximated to the NEAREST 1,000, exactly as the instructivo directs. Where a casilla has no value, write ZERO - do not leave it blank.

CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.EN: Severance savings deposited to the fund
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.ES: Auxilio de cesantia consignado al fondo de cesantias
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated for an employee under the Ley 50 de 1990 regime. Mutually exclusive with 'Severance savings under the traditional CST regime' (casilla 48) for the same employee. Must reconcile to the amount actually deposited under CO-CESANTIAS-006.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Format: N (whole pesos, nearest 1,000; zero where nil)
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: THE THIRD OF THREE SEVERANCE LINES. The amount DEPOSITED to the employee's chosen severance fund by 14 February for the balance at the preceding 31 December, under Ley 50 de 1990 art. 99. The engine must maintain all three buckets - paid to the employee, traditional regime, deposited to the fund - separately from the outset; they cannot be split retrospectively out of a single cesantias figure.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.OptionValues: -> Sheet 6: Las tres lineas de cesantias
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole Colombian pesos, approximated to the NEAREST 1,000, exactly as the instructivo directs. Where a casilla has no value, write ZERO - do not leave it blank.

CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.ES: Pensiones de jubilacion, vejez o invalidez

DIAN 000227 de 2025 art. 1.3.7.1.1 par. 7 sends it to Formato 5247 concepto 5102 instead.

CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole Colombian pesos, approximated to the NEAREST 1,000, exactly as the instructivo directs. Where a casilla has no value, write ZERO - do not leave it blank.

CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.ES: Aportes voluntarios a fondos de pensiones

CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.ES: Ingreso laboral promedio de los ultimos seis meses anteriores (numeral 4 art. 206 E.T.)
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Required only for employees to whom ET art. 206 num. 4 applies - that is, where severance savings or interest were paid or deposited. Bidirectional with casillas 47, 48 and 49: a certificate carrying any of those three should carry this average.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Format: N (whole pesos, nearest 1,000; zero where nil)
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: THE ROLLING SIX-MONTH AVERAGE that drives the ET art. 206 num. 4 severance exemption and its taper. Severance savings and the interest on them are EXEMPT IN FULL where this average does not exceed 350 UVT (COP 18,330,900 per month in 2026), and tapered above it. THE ENGINE MUST MAINTAIN THIS AVERAGE YEAR-ROUND - it cannot be reconstructed at year end from annual totals because it is a moving six-month window, and on a termination it is the average of the last six months OF EMPLOYMENT.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole Colombian pesos, approximated to the NEAREST 1,000, exactly as the instructivo directs. Where a casilla has no value, write ZERO - do not leave it blank.

CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Identity document type of the economic dependant, under ET art. 387 par. 2. The dependants deduction is 10% of gross employment income capped at 32 UVT per month (COP 1,675,968 in 2026), so a claimed dependant materially reduces the withholding base and must be evidenced.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated with casillas 79, 81 and 82. Bidirectional set.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Format: N / AN
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Identity number of the dependant. Also reported in Formato 2276 numeral 34, which is where DIAN cross-checks a dependant claimed by more than one taxpayer.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated with casillas 79, 80 and 82. Bidirectional set.

CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.section: =========== EMPLOYEE CERTIFICATION UNDER ET ART. 380 - DISPLAY-ONLY DECLARATIONS ===========

CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.ES: Certifico que durante el ano gravable (6 items)
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: The employee signs these ONLY where they intend the certificate to substitute for their income-tax return under DUR 1625 de 2016 art. 1.6.1.13.2.7. All six must be true together.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.PosFile: Printed block above the employee's signature
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Format: Display-only declaration
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: DISPLAY-ONLY - not a data field, not populated by payroll, not transmitted. The six declarations are: (1) gross wealth did not exceed 4,500 UVT; (2) gross income was below 1,400 UVT; (3) not a VAT-responsible person at 31 December; (4) credit-card consumption did not exceed 1,400 UVT; (5) total purchases and consumption did not exceed 1,400 UVT; (6) total bank deposits, receipts or financial investments did not exceed 1,400 UVT. Where all six hold, the note on the form states that THIS CERTIFICATE SUBSTITUTES FOR ALL LEGAL PURPOSES for the income-tax return. THIS IS THE ONLY REASON THE EMPLOYEE-DECLARED SECTIONS EXIST ON THE FORM.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Signed only where the employee makes the six art. 380 declarations. Bidirectional with the declaration block above it.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Format: Display-only
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: DISPLAY-ONLY. The employee's signature validating the declarations. Not a payroll field.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.ES: Nombre del pagador o agente retenedor
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Format: Text
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Name of the payer or withholding agent above the issuing signature. The certificate is ISSUED TO THE EMPLOYEE and RETAINED BY THE EMPLOYER - it is not filed with DIAN.
CO-DIAN-004-Formulario220-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.

CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.ES: Entidad informante
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.Format: N (code 1 to 8)
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: A CODE, not a name. Res. 227 art. 1.3.7.1.1 par. 3 prints the eight-value table: 1 Informante general, 2 Fiduciarias, 3 Mandatario y/o Administrador delegado, 4 Consorcio y/o Union Temporal, 5 Exploracion y Explotacion de hidrocarburos, gases y minerales, 6 Joint Venture, 7 Gestor en Cuentas en Participacion, 8 Convenios de cooperacion con entidades publicas. Par. 4 is categorical for payroll: 'cuando el empleador reporte pagos o abonos en cuenta por concepto de rentas de trabajo y de pensiones, la casilla Entidad Informante se debe diligenciar con el concepto 1 - Informante general', and the fideicomiso and contract-participant fields are then NOT filled.
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole pesos, no decimals, no thousand separators; zero-filled when nil (Res. 227 par. 2).
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.QueryRA: DERIVED - the XML element name is not published in Res. 227; confirm against the DIAN especificaciones tecnicas for Formato 2276 v4.

CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.EN: Beneficiary document type and identification number
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.ES: Tipo de documento y numero de identificacion del beneficiario
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.Format: N (code) + AN (number)
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: COMPOSITE FIELD as drafted in the resolution - numeral 2 names BOTH the document type and the number in a single numeral, and the technical specification splits them into two columns. Sub-field 1 = the identity-document type code; sub-field 2 = the identification number without dots or hyphens. PERSISTENCE: this pair is the join key across every Colombian artefact for the employee - nomina electronica NIE044 / NIE045, PILA Registro Tipo 2 campos 3 and 4, Formulario 220 casillas 24 and 25.
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.QueryRA: DERIVED - the XML element name is not published in Res. 227; confirm against the DIAN especificaciones tecnicas for Formato 2276 v4.

CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.ES: Apellidos y nombres del beneficiario
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.Format: A
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: COMPOSITE FIELD. CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Ahorro Voluntario Contractual with the Fondo Nacional del Ahorro. Maps to Formulario 220 casilla 58. The nomina electronica has NO dedicated element for AVC - it falls to OtraDeduccion (NIE197) - so the wage type must be tagged to recover the amount here.
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole pesos, no decimals, no thousand separators; zero-filled when nil (Res. 227 par. 2).
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.QueryRA: DERIVED - the XML element name is not published in Res. 227; confirm against the DIAN especificaciones tecnicas for Formato 2276 v4.

CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.EN: Withholding on work or pension income
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.ES: Valor de las retenciones en la fuente por pagos de rentas de trabajo o pensiones
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.Format: N (whole pesos, no decimals, no separators; zero when nil)
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: THE PRINCIPAL WITHHOLDING NUMERAL. For a RESIDENT it is the ET art. 383 table result under Procedure 1 or 2; for a NON-RESIDENT it is the flat 20% of ET art. 408 on the gross. Maps to Formulario 220 casilla 60, and the sum across the population reconciles to twelve months of Formulario 350 casilla 93.
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole pesos, no decimals, no thousand separators; zero-filled when nil (Res. 227 par. 2).
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.QueryRA: DERIVED - the XML element name is not published in Res. 227; confirm against the DIAN especificaciones tecnicas for Formato 2276 v4.

CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.EN: VAT as a higher cost or expense
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.ES: Impuesto sobre las Ventas (IVA), mayor valor del costo o gasto
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated by the client's tax function where non-deductible VAT attached to the payment. Payroll contributes nothing.
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.Format: N (whole pesos, no decimals, no separators; zero when nil)
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Non-deductible VAT treated as a higher cost or expense. Not a payroll figure; present in the format because Formato 2276 is a third-party information return covering all art. 383 work income, including payments to contractors.
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole pesos, no decimals, no thousand separators; zero-filled when nil (Res. 227 par. 2).
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.QueryRA: DERIVED - the XML element name is not published in Res. 227; confirm against the DIAN especificaciones tecnicas for Formato 2276 v4.

CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.ES: Retencion en la fuente a titulo de Impuesto sobre las Ventas (IVA)
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated by the client's tax function where VAT was withheld from the payment. Payroll contributes nothing.
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.Format: N (whole pesos, no decimals, no separators; zero when nil)
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: VAT withheld on the payment. Not a payroll figure - Colombian employment income carries no VAT. Relevant only where the beneficiary is a VAT-responsible contractor paid under the art. 383 table.
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole pesos, no decimals, no thousand separators; zero-filled when nil (Res. 227 par. 2).
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.QueryRA: DERIVED - the XML element name is not published in Res. 227; confirm against the DIAN especificaciones tecnicas for Formato 2276 v4.

CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.EN: Monthly meal payments up to 41 UVT
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.ES: Pagos por alimentacion mensuales hasta 41 UVT
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated where the employer made meal payments to a third party for an employee whose monthly salary does not exceed 310 UVT. Bidirectional pair with numeral 8 (the excess). Where the salary exceeds 310 UVT the whole payment falls to numeral 7 and BOTH this numeral and numeral 8 stay nil.
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.Format: N (whole pesos, no decimals, no separators; zero when nil)
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: INFORMATIVE ONLY. Res. 227 par. 1 says expressly: 'El valor a que hace referencia el numeral 32 de este articulo SE CONSIDERA DE CARACTER INFORMATIVO y corresponde a lo dispuesto en el articulo 387-1 del Estatuto Tributario'. It therefore does NOT enter the gross total in numeral 22 - the amount is not income of the employee at all, but of the food supplier. BIDIRECTIONAL PAIR WITH NUMERAL 8, which carries the excess above 41 UVT. Formulario 220 has NO counterpart casilla for this amount.
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole pesos, no decimals, no thousand separators; zero-filled when nil (Res. 227 par. 2).
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.QueryRA: DERIVED - the XML element name is not published in Res. 227; confirm against the DIAN especificaciones tecnicas for Formato 2276 v4.

CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.EN: Average labour income of the last six months
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.ES: Valor ingreso laboral promedio de los ultimos seis meses. Unicamente para trabajadores que aplique el numeral 4 articulo 206 E.T.
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated ONLY for employees to whom ET art. 206 num. 4 applies - that is, where severance or its interest was paid or deposited. Bidirectional with numerals 18, 19 and 20: a record carrying any of those three should carry this average.
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.Format: N (whole pesos, no decimals, no separators; zero when nil)
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: The rolling six-month average that drives the ET art. 206 num. 4 severance exemption and its taper - full exemption where it does not exceed 350 UVT (COP 18,330,900 per month in 2026). The resolution restricts it expressly: 'UNICAMENTE para trabajadores que aplique el numeral 4 articulo 206 E.T.'. The engine must maintain the average YEAR-ROUND; it cannot be reconstructed from annual totals.
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Whole pesos, no decimals, no thousand separators; zero-filled when nil (Res. 227 par. 2).
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.QueryRA: DERIVED - the XML element name is not published in Res. 227; confirm against the DIAN especificaciones tecnicas for Formato 2276 v4.

CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.EN: Economic dependant document type and identification number
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.ES: Tipo de documento y numero de identificacion del dependiente economico
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: Populated only where the employee claimed the ET art. 387 par. 2 dependants deduction during the year. Bidirectional with Formulario 220 casillas 79 to 82, which carry the same dependant with the addition of the name and relationship.
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.Format: N (code) + AN (number)
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: COMPOSITE FIELD - document type and number of the economic dependant claimed under ET art. 387 par. 2. Sub-field 1 = document type code; sub-field 2 = the number. THIS IS THE FIELD DIAN USES TO CROSS-CHECK a dependant claimed by more than one taxpayer, which is why it must agree with Formulario 220 casillas 79 and 80 exactly.
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.QueryRA: DERIVED - the XML element name is not published in Res. 227; confirm against the DIAN especificaciones tecnicas for Formato 2276 v4.

CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.ES: Identificacion del fideicomiso
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: MANDATORY where 'Reporting entity concept' (numeral 1) = 2 (Fiduciarias); MUST BE BLANK where numeral 1 = 1 (Informante general). Mutually exclusive with 'Contract participant document type and identification' (numeral 36). Bidirectional set with numeral 1.
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.Format: AN
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Populated ONLY where the reporting entity concept (numeral 1) is 2 - Fiduciarias - because the work income was paid out of trust assets. Res. 227 par. 4 directs that for an ordinary employer reporting under concepto 1 this field 'no se debe diligenciar'.
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.QueryRA: DERIVED - the XML element name is not published in Res. 227; confirm against the DIAN especificaciones tecnicas for Formato 2276 v4.

CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.EN: Contract participant document type and identification number
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.ES: Tipo documento e identificacion del participante en contrato
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.CondReason: MANDATORY where 'Reporting entity concept' (numeral 1) is 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 or 8; MUST BE BLANK where numeral 1 = 1 or 2. Mutually exclusive with 'Trust identification' (numeral 35). Bidirectional set with numeral 1.
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.Format: N (code) + AN (number)
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: COMPOSITE FIELD, populated ONLY where the reporting entity concept (numeral 1) is a collaboration-contract concept - 3 Mandatario, 4 Consorcio o Union Temporal, 5 Exploracion y explotacion, 6 Joint Venture, 7 Gestor en Cuentas en Participacion, 8 Convenios de cooperacion. Res. 227 par. 4 directs that for concepto 1 it 'no se debe diligenciar', and that where a collaboration contract IS reported, the trust field (numeral 35) is left blank instead.
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.QueryRA: DERIVED - the XML element name is not published in Res. 227; confirm against the DIAN especificaciones tecnicas for Formato 2276 v4.

CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.section: =========== FILING CONTROL FIELDS (not numerals - envelope and deadline drivers) ===========

CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.ES: NIT del informante
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.Format: N
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: NIT of the reporting employer. Res. 227 art. 1.3.9.1.3 keys the DEADLINE to it: the LAST digit for a Gran Contribuyente, the LAST TWO digits for a legal or natural person. This is a third deadline rule, different again from Formulario 350 (last digit, 7th-16th business day) and PILA (last two digits, 2nd-16th business day).
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.QueryRA: DERIVED - the XML element name is not published in Res. 227; confirm against the DIAN especificaciones tecnicas for Formato 2276 v4.

CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.ES: Calidad del informante
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.Format: Code
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: Gran Contribuyente, persona juridica y asimilada, or persona natural y asimilada. Res. 227 art. 1.3.9.1.3 par. 1 fixes the point at which it is tested: 'de acuerdo con la calidad de Gran Contribuyente, persona juridica o persona natural QUE SE POSEA EN EL MOMENTO DE INFORMAR' - the status held at the moment of filing, not at the year end being reported.
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.QueryRA: DERIVED - the XML element name is not published in Res. 227; confirm against the DIAN especificaciones tecnicas for Formato 2276 v4.

CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.ES: Ano gravable
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.Format: N (AAAA)
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: The fiscal year whose payments are reported. Filed in May or June of the FOLLOWING calendar year.
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.QueryRA: DERIVED - the XML element name is not published in Res. 227; confirm against the DIAN especificaciones tecnicas for Formato 2276 v4.

CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.ES: Formato y version
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.Format: Code
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.Explanation: A CONSTANT for this filing: Formato 2276, version 4. Res. 227 art. 1.3.10.1 lists it in the formats-and-technical-specifications table as T3.45. A version mismatch is rejected at upload.
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.Rounding: Not an amount - no rounding.
CO-DIAN-005-Formato2276-Spec.xlsx.QueryRA: DERIVED - the XML element name is not published in Res. 227; confirm against the DIAN especificaciones tecnicas for Formato 2276 v4.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..section: =========== ARCHIVO TIPO 1 - DATOS GENERALES DEL APORTANTE (34 campos, 567 posiciones) ===========

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: Nombre o razon social del aportante
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(200) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Registered name of the contributing employer. Supplied by the aportante and echoed into Archivo Tipo 2 Registro Tipo 1 campo 4, where the annex says expressly 'El registrado en el campo 1 del archivo tipo 1' - the two must be byte-identical.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(2) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Identity-document type of the employer, from the closed list NI, CC, CE, TI, PA, CD, SC, PE. For a corporate employer it is always NI (numero de identificacion tributaria). Echoed into T2R1 campo 5.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(16) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: The employer's identification number. The operador de informacion validates that it contains only A-Z and 0-9. An ALPHANUMERIC number is permitted ONLY for document types PA (pasaporte) and CD (carne diplomatico); for NI, CC, CE, TI, SC and PE it must be all digits. Echoed into T2R1 campo 6. Same number as Formulario 350 casilla 5 and nomina electronica NIE033.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: MANDATORY where 'Employer person type' (A1-009) = J (Juridica); for every other case the field must be ZERO. Bidirectional pair with A1-009.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(1) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: DIAN check digit of the employer NIT. The annex requires the operador de informacion to validate it against the DIAN algorithm. Echoed into T2R1 campo 7.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: Codigo de la sucursal o de la dependencia
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: MUST BE BLANK where 'Form of presentation' (A1-010) = U (Unico). Populated only where A1-010 = S (Sucursal). Bidirectional pair with A1-010 and with 'Branch name' (A1-006).
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(10) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Code of the branch or dependency filing this planilla. Echoed into T2R1 campo 12. A multi-branch employer files one planilla per branch under S; a single consolidated planilla uses U and leaves this blank.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: Nombre de la sucursal o de la dependencia
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Populated together with 'Branch or dependency code' (A1-005). The annex directs that where the branch has no name, the branch CODE is written here instead.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(40) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Name of the branch. Echoed into T2R1 campo 13. Where the branch is unnamed, repeat the code from A1-005 rather than leaving it blank.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: A = 200 or more contributors; B = fewer than 200; C = Mipyme electing the Ley 590 de 2000 parafiscal discounts; D = beneficiary of the Ley 1429 de 2010 formalisation regime. The headcount test for A and B counts contributors across ALL branches. For class C the operador de informacion must verify MONTHLY that the employer appears in the file DIAN sends the Ministry under Decreto 525 de 2009 art. 6 - so the class cannot simply be asserted.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(1) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: 1 Publica, 2 Privada, 3 Mixta, 4 Organismos multilaterales, 5 Entidades de derecho publico no sometidas a la legislacion colombiana. Private-sector corporate payroll is 2.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: N Natural or J Juridica. Where N, the valid document types in A1-002 narrow to CC, CE, TI, PA, CD, PE and SC - NI is not available to a natural person. Where J, the verification digit (A1-004) and the whole legal-representative block (A1-018 to A1-024) become mandatory.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: U Unico or S Sucursal. Determines whether the branch code and name (A1-005, A1-006) are filled or blank. Echoed into T2R1 campo 11.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(40) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Postal address of the employer for correspondence from the subsystem administrators.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(3) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: THREE-digit DANE DIVIPOLA municipality code - note that this is the municipality suffix ALONE, not the five-digit code used by the nomina electronica. Bogota D.C. is 001 here and 11001 there. Left BLANK where the 'Colombiano en el exterior' flag is marked.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(2) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Two-digit DANE DIVIPOLA department code. Concatenated with A1-012 it reconstructs the five-digit code used elsewhere: 11 + 001 = 11001, Bogota D.C.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: Codigo DANE de la actividad economica
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(4) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Four-digit economic activity from the CIIU revision 4 adapted for Colombia, issued by DANE through Resolucion 66 de 2012 or its successor. The SAME classification drives the DIAN self-withholding rate in Formulario 350 casilla 27; keep one code, consumed twice.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(10) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Contact telephone of the employer. Mandatory in the annex even though it plays no part in the settlement.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(10) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Fax number. Optional and, in practice, obsolete - but the ten positions remain reserved in the record and must be zero-filled if unused, because the field is typed N.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(60) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Employer e-mail. The annex prescribes the validation in detail: the local part may contain a-z, 0-9, hyphen, underscore, apostrophe and full stop; the separator must be the @ character; the domain may contain a-z, 0-9 and hyphen, and the hyphen may be neither the first nor the last character of the domain.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: Numero de identificacion del representante legal
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: MANDATORY where 'Employer person type' (A1-009) = J (Juridica); OPTIONAL where A1-009 = N (Natural). Bidirectional pair with A1-009 and with the legal-representative block A1-019 to A1-024.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(16) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Identity number of the legal representative. The operador validates that it contains only A-Z and 0-9. An alphanumeric value is permitted only for document types PA and CD; for CC and CE it must be all digits.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(1) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: The annex is explicit and counter-intuitive here: 'Este campo se debera reportar en cero'. It is ALWAYS zero, whatever the representative's document. Do not compute a check digit.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: MANDATORY where 'Employer person type' (A1-009) = J; optional where A1-009 = N. Bidirectional pair with A1-009 and A1-018.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(2) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Closed list of only four values: CC Cedula de ciudadania, CE Cedula de extranjeria, PA Pasaporte, CD Carne diplomatico. Narrower than the employer's own document-type list in A1-002 - NI, TI, SC and PE are not available for a legal representative.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: MANDATORY where 'Employer person type' (A1-009) = J. Bidirectional pair with A1-009.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(20) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: First surname of the legal representative.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(30) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Second surname. Supplied by the aportante; not mandatory even for a legal person, which accommodates a representative with a single surname - unlike the nomina electronica, where the employee's second surname is use=required (CO-GAP-07).

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: MANDATORY where 'Employer person type' (A1-009) = J. Bidirectional pair with A1-009.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(20) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: First given name of the legal representative.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(30) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Second given name. Optional.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..EN: Insolvency, restructuring, liquidation or cessation start date
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: Fecha de inicio del concordato, reestructuracion, liquidacion o cese de actividades
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Optional in general, but MANDATORY where 'Type of action' (A1-026) is populated. Bidirectional pair with A1-026: the annex says 'Es obligatorio cuando se diligencia informacion en el campo 26 de este archivo'.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(10) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Date from which the concordato, restructuring, liquidation or cessation of activities takes effect. Format AAAA-MM-DD. Used where there is no payroll and no payment.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Optional. Where populated, it makes 'Insolvency start date' (A1-025) mandatory and 'Commercial-activity cessation date' (A1-027) required. Bidirectional set with A1-025 and A1-027.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(1) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: 1 Concordato, 2 Reestructuracion, 3 Liquidacion, 4 Cese de actividades.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: Fecha en que termino actividades comerciales
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Optional in general; the annex directs that it 'se debe diligenciar cuando se ha reportado informacion en el campo 26 de este registro'. Bidirectional pair with A1-026.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(10) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Date from which the employer is no longer obliged to make contributions. Format AAAA-MM-DD. This is the field that stops the obligation - not the mere absence of employees.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(2) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Assigned by the system of the licensed operador de informacion, not by the employer. Colombia's social-security filing is intermediated: THE EMPLOYER NEVER TRANSACTS DIRECTLY WITH THE GOVERNMENT for contributions.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(7) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Assigned by the system. Format AAAA-MM, seven positions. The contribution period, not the payment date.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..QueryRA: TYPE / FORMAT CONFLICT IN THE OFFICIAL ANNEX, recorded. The layout table types this field as N (numeric, zero-filled) yet prescribes the format AAAA-MM, which occupies all seven positions only if it contains a hyphen - a non-numeric character. The equivalent header fields T2R1-015 and T2R1-016 are typed A for the same format. Confirm with the RA and with the chosen operador whether A1-029 is written as '2026-03' (hyphenated, as the format implies) or as '0202603' / '2026003' (some other seven-digit numeric form).

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(2) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Twelve-value list: 1 Empleador, 2 Independiente, 3 Entidades o universidades publicas de regimenes especial y de excepcion, 4 Agremiaciones/asociaciones/congregaciones religiosas, 5 Cooperativas y precooperativas de trabajo asociado, 6 Misiones diplomaticas/consulares/organismos multilaterales, 7 Organizaciones del Programa de Hogares de Bienestar, 8 Pagador de concejales y ediles, 9 Pagador contrato sindical, 10 Pagador programa de reincorporacion, 11 Pagador parafiscales del Magisterio, 12 Pagador prestacion humanitaria. Private corporate payroll is 1. Echoed into T2R1 campo 21, where the annex requires equality.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: MANDATORY for an employer benefiting from the Ley 1429 de 2010 formalisation regime - i.e. where 'Class of contributor' (A1-007) = D or 'Ley 1429 CCF benefit' (A1-034) = S. Bidirectional set with A1-007, A1-032 and A1-034.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(10) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Date of the commercial registry of the employer's principal seat. The annex restricts the admissible range to 29 December 2010 through 31 December 2014 - the Ley 1429 window. A date outside that range is rejected.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: MANDATORY for a Ley 1429 de 2010 beneficiary. Bidirectional set with A1-007, A1-031 and A1-034.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(2) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: DIVIPOLA department of the employer's principal domicile, as distinct from A1-013 which is the correspondence department. For most employers the two coincide.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..EN: Employer exonerated from health, SENA and ICBF contributions
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: Aportante exonerado de pago de aporte a salud, SENA e ICBF
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: S or N. THE SINGLE MOST CONSEQUENTIAL FLAG IN THE EMPLOYER RECORD. It declares that the employer is exonerated under ET art. 114-1 from the EMPLOYER health contribution of 8.5%, from the SENA levy of 2% and from the ICBF levy of 3%, for employees earning less than 10 SMMLV (COP 17,509,050 in 2026). It does NOT touch pension, occupational risk or the family compensation fund 4%, none of which is ever exonerated. The per-employee side of the same test is Registro Tipo 2 campo 76, and the DIAN side is Formulario 350 casilla 27 - configure the test once and consume it in all three places.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..EN: Employer electing Ley 1429 art. 5 benefits for the family compensation fund
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: Aportante que se acoge a los beneficios del articulo 5 de la Ley 1429 de 2010 con respecto al aporte para las cajas de compensacion familiar
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: S or N. Declares that the employer claims the Ley 1429 de 2010 art. 5 progressive relief on the 4% family-compensation-fund contribution. Distinct from the art. 114-1 exoneration in A1-033: the CCF 4% is NEVER exonerated under art. 114-1, so this is the only route to relief on it. Bidirectional set with A1-007 (class D), A1-031 and A1-032.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..section: =========== ARCHIVO TIPO 2, REGISTRO TIPO 1 - ENCABEZADO (22 campos, 359 posiciones) ===========

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(2) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: A CONSTANT. Must be 01 for the header record of Archivo Tipo 2. The detail records that follow carry 02 in the same two positions, which is how a parser distinguishes them.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(1) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: 1 Electronica - the employer keys or uploads the settlement on the operador's web site; 2 Asistida - the employer telephones the operador's call centre and the operador keys it. The annex adds that where Decreto 780 de 2016 art. 3.2.3.9 par. 2 exceptionally allows assisted payment, the field must still say ELECTRONICA, and the operador reports those employers separately to the Ministry through SISPRO structure PUB019EXPE by the fifth business day of the following month.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(4) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Header sequence number within the file.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: Nombre o razon social del aportante
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(200) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Must be identical to Archivo Tipo 1 campo 1 - the annex says 'El registrado en el campo 1 del archivo tipo 1'. Any divergence between the two files is a validation failure at the operador, not at the Ministry.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(2) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Must equal Archivo Tipo 1 campo 2.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(16) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Must equal Archivo Tipo 1 campo 3. The LAST TWO DIGITS of this number determine the PILA filing deadline - the 2nd to 16th business day of the following month - which is a different rule from Formulario 350, where only the LAST digit matters.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(1) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Must equal Archivo Tipo 1 campo 4.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Single letter selecting the settlement type. E Planilla empleados is the ordinary monthly employer planilla. The full list also carries Y (independientes empresas), A (cotizantes con novedad de ingreso), I (independientes), S (servicio domestico), M (mora), N (correcciones), H (madres sustitutas), T and F (Sistema General de Participaciones - DESCOPED, public sector only), J (sentencia judicial), X (empresa liquidada), U (uso UGPP pago por terceros), K (estudiantes) and O (obligaciones determinadas por la UGPP). Types I and Y are descoped in scope_manifest - the contribution base for an independent worker is 40% of fees, not salary.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: Numero de la planilla asociada a esta planilla
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: MUST BE BLANK where 'Planilla type' (T2R1-008) is E, A, I, M, S, Y, T, X or K. Populated where the type is N or F (the period planilla being corrected or completed), U (the judicial deposit title), J (the planilla of the original payment) or O (the planilla of the payment that produced the UGPP inexactitud). In all other cases the field is ZERO. Bidirectional pair with T2R1-008 and with 'Associated planilla payment date' (T2R1-010).
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(10) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: The planilla number this settlement relates back to. It is what turns a correction (N) or a late payment (M) into an amendment of a specific earlier filing rather than a new one.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: Fecha de pago Planilla asociada a esta planilla. (AAAA-MM-DD)
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: MUST BE BLANK where 'Planilla type' (T2R1-008) is E, A, I, M, S, Y, T, X or K. Populated in the same cases as 'Associated planilla number' (T2R1-009), with which it is a bidirectional pair.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(10) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Payment date of the associated planilla, format AAAA-MM-DD. For planilla type U the UGPP enters the date the judicial deposit was constituted.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Must equal Archivo Tipo 1 campo 10.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: Codigo de la sucursal del aportante
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Must equal Archivo Tipo 1 campo 5, and is therefore blank where 'Form of presentation' (T2R1-011) = U. Bidirectional pair with T2R1-011.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(10) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Branch code, echoed from Archivo Tipo 1.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Must equal Archivo Tipo 1 campo 6; populated together with 'Branch code' (T2R1-012).
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(40) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Branch name, echoed from Archivo Tipo 1.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: Codigo de la ARL a la cual el aportante se encuentra afiliado
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(6) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Code of the occupational-risk insurer (Administradora de Riesgos Laborales) to which the EMPLOYER is affiliated. The employer has one ARL; the per-employee ARL in Registro Tipo 2 campo 77 normally matches it, but the RISK CLASS varies by work centre, not by employer.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..EN: Payment period for subsystems other than health
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: Periodo de pago para los sistemas
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(7) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Format AAAA-MM, CALCULATED BY THE OPERADOR, not supplied by the employer. Covers pension, occupational risk and the parafiscal levies.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..EN: Payment period for the health subsystem
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: Periodo de pago para el sistema de salud.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(7) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Format AAAA-MM, SUPPLIED BY THE EMPLOYER. COLOMBIA'S MOST-MISSED PILA RULE: health is paid ONE MONTH IN ADVANCE, so the health period is normally the month AFTER the period in T2R1-015. A settlement for March salaries carries pension period 2026-03 and health period 2026-04. Getting these equal is the classic first-run defect.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: Numero de radicacion o de la Planilla Integrada de Liquidacion de Aportes.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(10) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Assigned by the operador's system and unique per operador. This is the number the employer quotes in any later correction, and the number the inbound settlement response returns.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(10) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Assigned by the system from the effective payment date, format AAAA-MM-DD. Where it falls after the statutory deadline the operador computes interest on arrears and the planilla becomes a mora settlement.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: Numero total de cotizantes reportados en esta planilla.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(5) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Must equal the number of UNIQUE contributors in the Registro Tipo 2 detail, EXCLUDING those whose 'Tipo cotizante' (T2R2-005) is 40 - Beneficiario UPC Adicional. That exclusion is easy to miss and produces a header-to-detail mismatch that the operador rejects.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(12) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: The annex defines it precisely: 'la sumatoria de los IBC para el pago de los aportes de PARAFISCALES de la totalidad de los empleados'. It is the PARAFISCAL base - Registro Tipo 2 campo 95 - NOT the pension or health base. The two differ because the parafiscal base is uncapped and includes paid rest days (Ley 21 de 1982 art. 17), whereas the contribution bases are capped at 25 SMMLV. May be zero for a planilla of independent workers.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Rounding: Round UP. Contribution base to the whole peso; each contribution value to the next multiple of 100 (Decreto 1990 de 2016 art. 1).

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(2) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Mandatory and must be EQUAL to Archivo Tipo 1 campo 30. The annex states the equality expressly.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(2) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Assigned by the operador's system. Same value as Archivo Tipo 1 campo 28.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..section: =========== ARCHIVO TIPO 2, REGISTRO TIPO 2 - LIQUIDACION DETALLADA (97 campos, 686 posiciones) ===========

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(2) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: A CONSTANT. Must be 02 for a detail record. Distinguishes it from the 01 header in the same file.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(5) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Must start at 00001 and be strictly sequential for the remaining detail records in the file.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(2) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Closed list CC, CE, TI, PA, CD, SC, PE, RC. An ALPHANUMERIC identification number is permitted only for PA and CD; for TI, CC, SC, RC, CE and PE the number must be all digits. NOTE the divergence from the nomina electronica, which uses NUMERIC codes (13 = CC) rather than these two-letter codes - the engine must MAP, not copy.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(16) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
