CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Identity number of the contributor. Join key to the nomina electronica NIE045, to Formulario 220 casilla 25 and to Formato 2276 numeral 2.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(2) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: The full PILA tipo cotizante list - far longer than the sixteen values the nomina electronica recognises. Values include 1 Dependiente, 2 Servicio domestico, 3 Independiente, 4 Madre sustituta, 12 and 19 Aprendices, 16, 18, 20 to 23, 30 to 36, 40 Beneficiario UPC Adicional, 42 to 45, 47, 51 to 63. Codes 3, 16, 20, 32 to 45, 52, 53, 55, 57 and 59 to 63 have NO nomina electronica equivalent, so a direct copy will fail DIAN validation. Type 40 is additionally excluded from the header count in T2R1-019.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(2) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Twelve-value list: 0 No aplica, 1 Dependiente pensionado por vejez/jubilacion/invalidez activo, 2 Independiente pensionado, 3 No obligado a cotizar a pensiones por edad, 4 Requisitos cumplidos para pension, 5 Indemnizacion sustitutiva o devolucion de saldos reconocida, 6 Regimen exceptuado de pensiones, 9 Pensionado con mesada >= 25 SMLMV, 10 Residente en el exterior afiliado voluntario, 11 and 12 Conductores de taxi. HARD RULE printed in the annex: where the sub-type is 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 9 or 12, campo 46 (pension contribution rate) MUST be 0. Only sub-types 0 and 1 have a nomina electronica equivalent.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..EN: Foreign national not liable to contribute to pensions
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: Extranjero no obligado a cotizar a pensiones
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Blank or X. Where marked, the ONLY valid document types in 'Contributor document type' (T2R2-003) are CE, PA, CD, SC and PE. Bidirectional pair with T2R2-003.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Marks a foreign employee who proves affiliation to a pension system abroad and elects out of Colombian pension affiliation under Decreto 1072 de 2015 art. 2.2.1.2.1.4. Health, occupational risk and the parafiscal levies remain fully payable - only pension is waived.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Blank or X. Used only where 'Contributor document type' (T2R2-003) is CC or TI. Where marked, the work-location department and municipality (T2R2-009 and T2R2-010) must be left BLANK. Bidirectional set with T2R2-003, T2R2-009 and T2R2-010.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Marks a Colombian national contributing from abroad. Its practical effect on this record is to suppress the DIVIPOLA work-location fields, which have no meaning outside Colombia.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: Codigo del departamento de la ubicacion laboral
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Left BLANK where 'Colombian abroad' (T2R2-008) is marked, and where 'Contributor type' (T2R2-005) = 40 (Beneficiario UPC Adicional). Bidirectional set with T2R2-008 and T2R2-005.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(2) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: DIVIPOLA department where the work is performed. The operador validates it against the DANE DIVIPOLA catalogue. Should reconcile to nomina electronica NIE051.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: Codigo del municipio de ubicacion laboral
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Left BLANK in the same two cases as 'Work location department code' (T2R2-009) - 'Colombian abroad' marked, or contributor type 40. Bidirectional set with T2R2-008 and T2R2-005.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(3) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: THREE-digit DIVIPOLA municipality suffix - not the five-digit code used by the nomina electronica. Concatenate with T2R2-009 to obtain the five-digit form: 11 + 001 = 11001. Should reconcile to NIE052.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(20) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: First surname of the contributor. Mandatory.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(30) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Second surname. NOT mandatory here - a material contrast with the nomina electronica, where SegundoApellido is use=required and a single-surname employee forces a placeholder (CO-GAP-07). The same employee can therefore be reported correctly in PILA and imperfectly in the XML.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(20) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: First given name. Mandatory.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(30) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Second given name. Optional.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Change-event (novedad) flag. Populated only in the month the event occurs, and only for the employee it affects. The whole novedad block T2R2-015 to T2R2-030 is mutually constraining: the flag drives which of the date fields T2R2-080 to T2R2-097 become mandatory, and it drives the day counts in T2R2-036 to T2R2-039. Permitted values are blank, R, X or C. Where marked, 'Hire date' (T2R2-080) becomes mandatory.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Marks the employee's entry into the contribution system in this period. Drives the proportional day counts in campos 36 to 39 and pairs with the hire date in campo 80.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Change-event (novedad) flag. Populated only in the month the event occurs, and only for the employee it affects. The whole novedad block T2R2-015 to T2R2-030 is mutually constraining: the flag drives which of the date fields T2R2-080 to T2R2-097 become mandatory, and it drives the day counts in T2R2-036 to T2R2-039. Permitted values are blank, P, R, X or C. Where marked, 'Termination date' (T2R2-081) becomes mandatory.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Marks the employee's exit. Pairs with the termination date in campo 81 and reduces the contributory days in campos 36 to 39.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: TDE: Traslado desde otra EPS o EOC
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Change-event (novedad) flag. Populated only in the month the event occurs, and only for the employee it affects. The whole novedad block T2R2-015 to T2R2-030 is mutually constraining: the flag drives which of the date fields T2R2-080 to T2R2-097 become mandatory, and it drives the day counts in T2R2-036 to T2R2-039. Blank or X. Pairs with 'EPS to which the member belongs' (T2R2-033).
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Transfer INTO the reported health insurer from another EPS or EOC.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: TAE: Traslado a otra EPS o EOC
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Change-event (novedad) flag. Populated only in the month the event occurs, and only for the employee it affects. The whole novedad block T2R2-015 to T2R2-030 is mutually constraining: the flag drives which of the date fields T2R2-080 to T2R2-097 become mandatory, and it drives the day counts in T2R2-036 to T2R2-039. Blank or X. Where marked, 'EPS to which the member transfers' (T2R2-034) becomes mandatory. Bidirectional pair with T2R2-034.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Transfer OUT to another health insurer. The destination EPS code goes in campo 34.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..EN: TDP - transfer from another pension administrator
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: TDP: Traslado desde otra administradora de pensiones
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Change-event (novedad) flag. Populated only in the month the event occurs, and only for the employee it affects. The whole novedad block T2R2-015 to T2R2-030 is mutually constraining: the flag drives which of the date fields T2R2-080 to T2R2-097 become mandatory, and it drives the day counts in T2R2-036 to T2R2-039. Blank or X. Pairs with 'Pension fund to which the member belongs' (T2R2-031).
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Transfer INTO the reported pension administrator.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..EN: TAP - transfer to another pension administrator
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: TAP: Traslado a otra administradora de pensiones
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Change-event (novedad) flag. Populated only in the month the event occurs, and only for the employee it affects. The whole novedad block T2R2-015 to T2R2-030 is mutually constraining: the flag drives which of the date fields T2R2-080 to T2R2-097 become mandatory, and it drives the day counts in T2R2-036 to T2R2-039. Blank or X. Where marked, 'Pension fund to which the member transfers' (T2R2-032) becomes mandatory. Bidirectional pair with T2R2-032.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Transfer OUT to another pension administrator. Colombia permits a regime change every five years, so this is a recurring event, not an exception.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Change-event (novedad) flag. Populated only in the month the event occurs, and only for the employee it affects. The whole novedad block T2R2-015 to T2R2-030 is mutually constraining: the flag drives which of the date fields T2R2-080 to T2R2-097 become mandatory, and it drives the day counts in T2R2-036 to T2R2-039. Blank or X. Where marked, 'VSP start date' (T2R2-082) becomes mandatory. Bidirectional pair with T2R2-082.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: A permanent change in salary taking effect during the period. Distinct from VST (campo 23), which is transitory. The distinction matters: a permanent variation resets the contribution base going forward, a transitory one does not.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Change-event (novedad) flag. Populated only in the month the event occurs, and only for the employee it affects. The whole novedad block T2R2-015 to T2R2-030 is mutually constraining: the flag drives which of the date fields T2R2-080 to T2R2-097 become mandatory, and it drives the day counts in T2R2-036 to T2R2-039. Permitted values are blank, A or C. Used with planilla type N in 'Planilla type' (T2R1-008). Bidirectional pair with T2R1-008.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: A adds a contributor omitted from the original planilla; C corrects a contributor already reported. Only meaningful on a correction planilla.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Change-event (novedad) flag. Populated only in the month the event occurs, and only for the employee it affects. The whole novedad block T2R2-015 to T2R2-030 is mutually constraining: the flag drives which of the date fields T2R2-080 to T2R2-097 become mandatory, and it drives the day counts in T2R2-036 to T2R2-039. Blank or X.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: A one-off variation in the contribution base for this period only - typically a bonus or a retroactive payment - that does not change the standing salary.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..EN: SLN - contract suspension or unpaid leave
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: SLN: Suspension temporal del contrato de trabajo o licencia no remunerada o comision de servicios
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Change-event (novedad) flag. Populated only in the month the event occurs, and only for the employee it affects. The whole novedad block T2R2-015 to T2R2-030 is mutually constraining: the flag drives which of the date fields T2R2-080 to T2R2-097 become mandatory, and it drives the day counts in T2R2-036 to T2R2-039. Permitted values are blank, X or C. Where marked, 'SLN start date' (T2R2-083) and 'SLN end date' (T2R2-084) become mandatory. Bidirectional set with T2R2-083 and T2R2-084.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Temporary suspension of the contract, unpaid leave, or a commission of service. Reduces the contributory days in campos 36 to 39 and must reconcile to the nomina electronica LicenciaNR block (NIE136 to NIE138).

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: IGE: Incapacidad temporal por enfermedad general.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Change-event (novedad) flag. Populated only in the month the event occurs, and only for the employee it affects. The whole novedad block T2R2-015 to T2R2-030 is mutually constraining: the flag drives which of the date fields T2R2-080 to T2R2-097 become mandatory, and it drives the day counts in T2R2-036 to T2R2-039. Blank or X. Where marked, 'IGE start date' (T2R2-085) and 'IGE end date' (T2R2-086) become mandatory, and campos 57 and 58 (authorisation number and value) become relevant. Bidirectional set with T2R2-085, T2R2-086, T2R2-057 and T2R2-058.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Sick leave for general illness. The employer bears days 1-2 and the EPS funds from day 3. Maps to nomina electronica Incapacidad with Tipo = 1 (Comun).

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: LMA: Licencia de Maternidad o de paternidad.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Change-event (novedad) flag. Populated only in the month the event occurs, and only for the employee it affects. The whole novedad block T2R2-015 to T2R2-030 is mutually constraining: the flag drives which of the date fields T2R2-080 to T2R2-097 become mandatory, and it drives the day counts in T2R2-036 to T2R2-039. Blank or X. Where marked, 'LMA start date' (T2R2-087) and 'LMA end date' (T2R2-088) become mandatory, and campos 59 and 60 become relevant. Bidirectional set with T2R2-087, T2R2-088, T2R2-059 and T2R2-060.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Maternity or paternity leave, funded by the EPS and advanced by the employer. Maps to the nomina electronica LicenciaMP block (NIE128 to NIE131).

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Change-event (novedad) flag. Populated only in the month the event occurs, and only for the employee it affects. The whole novedad block T2R2-015 to T2R2-030 is mutually constraining: the flag drives which of the date fields T2R2-080 to T2R2-097 become mandatory, and it drives the day counts in T2R2-036 to T2R2-039. Permitted values are X (vacaciones), L (licencia remunerada) or blank. Where marked, 'VAC-LR start date' (T2R2-089) and 'VAC-LR end date' (T2R2-090) become mandatory. Bidirectional set with T2R2-089 and T2R2-090.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: A THREE-VALUE flag, not a simple X: X means vacation, L means remunerated leave. They map to two DIFFERENT nomina electronica blocks - VacacionesComunes (NIE109 to NIE112) and LicenciaR (NIE132 to NIE135) respectively - so the value carries real information and must not be normalised to X.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Change-event (novedad) flag. Populated only in the month the event occurs, and only for the employee it affects. The whole novedad block T2R2-015 to T2R2-030 is mutually constraining: the flag drives which of the date fields T2R2-080 to T2R2-097 become mandatory, and it drives the day counts in T2R2-036 to T2R2-039. Blank or X. Where marked, campos 48 and 49 (member and employer voluntary pension contributions) become relevant. Bidirectional set with T2R2-048 and T2R2-049.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Signals that a voluntary pension contribution is included in this settlement.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Change-event (novedad) flag. Populated only in the month the event occurs, and only for the employee it affects. The whole novedad block T2R2-015 to T2R2-030 is mutually constraining: the flag drives which of the date fields T2R2-080 to T2R2-097 become mandatory, and it drives the day counts in T2R2-036 to T2R2-039. Blank or X. Where marked, 'VCT start date' (T2R2-091) and 'VCT end date' (T2R2-092) become mandatory, and 'Work centre' (T2R2-062) changes. Bidirectional set with T2R2-091, T2R2-092 and T2R2-062.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Change of work centre during the period. It matters because THE OCCUPATIONAL-RISK CLASS ATTACHES TO THE WORK CENTRE, NOT TO THE EMPLOYER (Decreto 1072 de 2015 art. 2.2.4.2.5.6), so a move can change the ARL rate mid-period.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..EN: IRL - days of occupational accident or disease incapacity
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: IRL: Dias de incapacidad por accidente de trabajo o enfermedad laboral.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Change-event (novedad) flag. Populated only in the month the event occurs, and only for the employee it affects. The whole novedad block T2R2-015 to T2R2-030 is mutually constraining: the flag drives which of the date fields T2R2-080 to T2R2-097 become mandatory, and it drives the day counts in T2R2-036 to T2R2-039. Zero, or a day count between 01 and 30. Where non-zero, 'IRL start date' (T2R2-093) and 'IRL end date' (T2R2-094) become mandatory. Bidirectional set with T2R2-093 and T2R2-094.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(2) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: UNLIKE THE OTHER NOVEDAD FLAGS THIS ONE CARRIES A NUMBER, not an X: it is the count of days of incapacity arising from an occupational accident or disease, funded by the ARL from day one at 100%. Maps to nomina electronica Incapacidad with Tipo = 2 or 3.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: Codigo de la administradora de fondos de pensiones a la cual pertenece el afiliado
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Mandatory in general. Blank is permitted ONLY where 'Contributor type' (T2R2-005) or 'Contributor sub-type' (T2R2-006) is one that is not obliged to contribute to the Sistema General de Pensiones. Bidirectional set with T2R2-005 and T2R2-006.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(6) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Code of the pension administrator - either Colpensiones in the average-premium regime or a private individual-account fund. The employee elects the regime and may change it every five years.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..EN: Pension fund to which the member transfers
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: Codigo de la administradora de fondos de pensiones a la cual se traslada el afiliado
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Mandatory where 'TAP - transfer to another pension administrator' (T2R2-020) is marked; blank otherwise. Bidirectional pair with T2R2-020.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(6) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Destination pension administrator on a regime or fund change.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..EN: EPS or EOC of the member
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: Codigo EPS o EOC a la cual pertenece el afiliado
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(6) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Code of the health insurer. Health is the subsystem paid one month in advance, per T2R1-016.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..EN: EPS or EOC to which the member transfers
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: Codigo EPS o EOC a la cual se traslada el afiliado
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Mandatory where 'TAE - transfer to another EPS' (T2R2-018) is marked; blank otherwise. Bidirectional pair with T2R2-018.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(6) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Destination health insurer on a transfer.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: Codigo CCF a la cual pertenece el afiliado
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(6) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Code of the family compensation fund. Organised by department, so a multi-site employer legitimately reports several CCF codes across its population - the 4% rate does not vary, only the receiving institution.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: Numero de dias cotizados a pension
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(2) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Contributory days for the pension subsystem on the 30-day commercial month. EACH SUBSYSTEM CARRIES ITS OWN DAY COUNT and they legitimately differ - which is precisely why the engine must compute and store four separate counters rather than one 'days worked'.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: Numero de dias cotizados a salud
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(2) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Contributory days for health. Diverges from the pension count during unpaid leave, where health may still be payable under some configurations while pension is not.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: Numero de dias cotizados a Riesgos Laborales
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(2) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Contributory days for the occupational-risk subsystem.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..EN: Days contributed to the family compensation fund
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: Numero de dias cotizados a Caja de Compensacion Familiar
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(2) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Contributory days for the family compensation fund.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(9) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: The employee's basic salary. Distinct from the four IBC fields that follow: the IBC is the contribution base after non-salary payments, the 40% clamp and the ceiling and floor, whereas this is the contractual salary itself.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Rounding: Round UP. Contribution base to the whole peso; each contribution value to the next multiple of 100 (Decreto 1990 de 2016 art. 1).

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: X where the employee is on an all-inclusive salary under CST art. 132 num. 2 (minimum 13 SMMLV). Where marked, the four IBC fields (T2R2-042 to T2R2-045) must be 70% of the integral salary. Bidirectional set with T2R2-042 to T2R2-045.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Marks salario integral. The 70% rule is the single most consequential consequence: the contribution base is 70% of the integral salary, not 100%, because 30% is the statutory prestacional factor. Maps to nomina electronica SalarioIntegral (NIE056).

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(9) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Contribution base for pension. FLOOR 1 SMMLV = COP 1,750,905; CEILING 25 SMMLV = COP 43,772,625 in 2026. Must reconcile to nomina electronica NIE166 divided by the rate in T2R2-046, allowing for the different rounding conventions.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Rounding: Round UP. Contribution base to the whole peso; each contribution value to the next multiple of 100 (Decreto 1990 de 2016 art. 1).

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(9) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Contribution base for health. Same floor and ceiling as pension. The four IBC values legitimately DIFFER from one another once a non-salary payment, a change event or a subsystem-specific rule enters - do not populate them from one variable.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Rounding: Round UP. Contribution base to the whole peso; each contribution value to the next multiple of 100 (Decreto 1990 de 2016 art. 1).

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(9) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Contribution base for occupational risk. Same floor and ceiling.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Rounding: Round UP. Contribution base to the whole peso; each contribution value to the next multiple of 100 (Decreto 1990 de 2016 art. 1).

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(9) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Contribution base for the family compensation fund. Same floor and ceiling as the other three, but NOT the same as the parafiscal base in campo 95, which is uncapped.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Rounding: Round UP. Contribution base to the whole peso; each contribution value to the next multiple of 100 (Decreto 1990 de 2016 art. 1).

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..EN: Contribution base for parafiscals other than the CCF
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: IBC otros parafiscales diferentes a CCF
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(9) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: THE FIFTH AND MOST-MISSED BASE. The base for SENA, ICBF, ESAP and MEN. Ley 21 de 1982 art. 17 defines it differently from the contribution bases: it includes paid rest days and it is UNCAPPED - the 25-SMMLV ceiling does not apply. Header campo T2R1-020 is the sum of THIS field across the population, not of campo 45.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Rounding: Round UP. Contribution base to the whole peso; each contribution value to the next multiple of 100 (Decreto 1990 de 2016 art. 1).

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(7) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: TOTAL pension rate - employer 12% plus employee 4% = 16% (Ley 100 de 1993 art. 20 as substituted by Ley 797 de 2003 art. 7). HARD RULE from the annex: where 'Contributor sub-type' (T2R2-006) is 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 9 or 12, THIS FIELD MUST BE 0. A high-risk employee under Decreto Ley 2090 de 2003 carries an additional employer charge - see scope_manifest CO-GAP-02, which must be resolved before configuring one.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Rounding: Rate expressed with implied decimals in 7 positions.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..QueryRA: CO-GAP-02: confirm the 2026 high-risk additional pension rate and its base before configuring any Decreto Ley 2090 de 2003 employee.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(9) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: 16% of the pension IBC - the WHOLE contribution, employer and employee together. The nomina electronica reports only the employee's 4% (NIE166); this field reports 16%. They are not interchangeable.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Rounding: Round UP. Contribution base to the whole peso; each contribution value to the next multiple of 100 (Decreto 1990 de 2016 art. 1).

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..EN: Member's voluntary contribution to the mandatory pension fund
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: Aporte voluntario del afiliado al fondo de pensiones obligatorias.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Populated where 'AVP - voluntary contribution' (T2R2-028) is marked. Bidirectional pair with T2R2-028 and with T2R2-049.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(9) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Voluntary contribution made BY THE EMPLOYEE into the mandatory pension fund.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Rounding: Round UP. Contribution base to the whole peso; each contribution value to the next multiple of 100 (Decreto 1990 de 2016 art. 1).

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..EN: Employer's voluntary contribution to the mandatory pension fund
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: Aporte voluntario del aportante al fondo de pensiones obligatoria.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Populated where 'AVP - voluntary contribution' (T2R2-028) is marked. Bidirectional pair with T2R2-028 and with T2R2-048.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(9) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Voluntary contribution made BY THE EMPLOYER into the employee's mandatory pension fund.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Rounding: Round UP. Contribution base to the whole peso; each contribution value to the next multiple of 100 (Decreto 1990 de 2016 art. 1).

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..EN: Total contribution to the general pension system
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: Total cotizacion Sistema General de Pensiones
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(9) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Sum of the mandatory contribution and both voluntary contributions. This is the figure the pension administrator receives.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Rounding: Round UP. Contribution base to the whole peso; each contribution value to the next multiple of 100 (Decreto 1990 de 2016 art. 1).

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: Aportes a fondo de solidaridad pensional - subcuenta de solidaridad.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Payable only where the contribution base is at or above 4 SMMLV (COP 7,003,620 in 2026). Bidirectional pair with 'Solidarity pension fund - subsistence sub-account' (T2R2-052), which has a HIGHER 16-SMMLV trigger, and with the pension IBC in T2R2-042.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(9) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: 1% of the contribution base, borne ENTIRELY BY THE EMPLOYEE and additional to the 4% pension. Reconciles to nomina electronica NIE168.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Rounding: Round UP. Contribution base to the whole peso; each contribution value to the next multiple of 100 (Decreto 1990 de 2016 art. 1).

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: Aportes a fondo de solidaridad pensional - subcuenta de subsistencia.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Payable only where the contribution base is at or above 16 SMMLV (COP 28,014,480 in 2026) - a HIGHER trigger than the solidarity sub-account. Cannot be present unless T2R2-051 is also present. Bidirectional pair with T2R2-051.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(9) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Banded 0.2% to 1.0% by contribution base, employee-borne. Reconciles to nomina electronica NIE170. Reported SEPARATELY from the solidarity sub-account in both artefacts - never merged.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..OptionValues: -> Sheet 6: Bandas del fondo de solidaridad pensional
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Rounding: Round UP. Contribution base to the whole peso; each contribution value to the next multiple of 100 (Decreto 1990 de 2016 art. 1).

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..EN: Value not withheld for voluntary contributions
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: Valor no retenido por aportes voluntarios.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Populated where a voluntary contribution reduces the amount withheld. Related to T2R2-048 and T2R2-049.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(9) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Amount of voluntary contribution not withheld from the employee in the period.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Rounding: Round UP. Contribution base to the whole peso; each contribution value to the next multiple of 100 (Decreto 1990 de 2016 art. 1).

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(7) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: TOTAL health rate - employer 8.5% plus employee 4% = 12.5%. WHERE THE ART. 114-1 EXONERATION APPLIES (see T2R2-076) the employer's 8.5% falls away and only the employee's 4% is due, so the effective rate reported becomes 4%. This is the field where the exoneration becomes visible in money terms.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Rounding: Rate expressed with implied decimals in 7 positions.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(9) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Health contribution actually due. For an exonerated employee earning under 10 SMMLV this is the employee's 4% alone; for a non-exonerated employee it is the full 12.5%. Reconciles to nomina electronica NIE163 for the employee portion.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Rounding: Round UP. Contribution base to the whole peso; each contribution value to the next multiple of 100 (Decreto 1990 de 2016 art. 1).

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Populated only for contributor type 40 (Beneficiario UPC Adicional) in 'Contributor type' (T2R2-005). Bidirectional pair with T2R2-005; note that type 40 is also EXCLUDED from the header contributor count in T2R1-019.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(9) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Additional capitation-unit premium for a beneficiary in a higher-cost health plan. Not part of ordinary corporate payroll.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Rounding: Round UP. Contribution base to the whole peso; each contribution value to the next multiple of 100 (Decreto 1990 de 2016 art. 1).

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: N° autorizacion de la incapacidad por enfermedad general
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Populated where 'IGE' (T2R2-025) is marked. Bidirectional set with T2R2-025 and with 'General-illness incapacity value' (T2R2-058).
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(15) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Authorisation number issued by the EPS for the sick-leave benefit. Fifteen alphanumeric positions. Without it the EPS will not reimburse the employer's advance.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: Valor de la incapacidad por enfermedad general
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Populated where 'IGE' (T2R2-025) is marked. Bidirectional pair with T2R2-057.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(9) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Money value of the general-illness incapacity in the period. The employer ADVANCES it and recovers from the EPS - see the inbound EPS/ARL determination in the Report Matrix.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Rounding: Round UP. Contribution base to the whole peso; each contribution value to the next multiple of 100 (Decreto 1990 de 2016 art. 1).

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..EN: Maternity or paternity leave authorisation number
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: N° de autorizacion de la licencia de maternidad o paternidad
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Populated where 'LMA' (T2R2-026) is marked. Bidirectional set with T2R2-026 and with 'Maternity leave value' (T2R2-060).
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(15) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Authorisation number issued by the EPS for the maternity or paternity benefit.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: Valor de la licencia de maternidad
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Populated where 'LMA' (T2R2-026) is marked. Bidirectional pair with T2R2-059.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(9) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Money value of the maternity or paternity leave. Advanced by the employer, funded by the EPS.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Rounding: Round UP. Contribution base to the whole peso; each contribution value to the next multiple of 100 (Decreto 1990 de 2016 art. 1).

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: Tarifa de aportes a Riesgos Laborales.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(9) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Rate for the employee's risk class, EMPLOYER-BORNE IN FULL - there is no employee occupational-risk deduction in Colombia, which is why no nomina electronica element corresponds to it. Initial rates by class: I 0.522%, II 1.044%, III 2.436%, IV 4.350%, V 6.960%, within statutory minimum-maximum ranges of 0.348% to 8.7%. THE CLASS ATTACHES TO THE WORK CENTRE, not to the employer.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Populated where the employer has more than one work centre, and mandatory where 'VCT - change of work centre' (T2R2-029) is marked. Bidirectional set with T2R2-029 and with 'Risk class' (T2R2-078).
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(9) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Identifier of the work centre to which the employee is attached. It determines the occupational-risk class and therefore the rate: a company with two work centres legitimately carries two risk classes (Decreto 1072 de 2015 art. 2.2.4.2.5.6). Where a person performs several occupations they contribute at the HIGHEST class.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: Cotizacion obligatoria al Sistema General de Riesgos Laborales
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(9) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: The occupational-risk premium. Employer cost in full. NOTE the rounding: 0.522% of 12,000,000 is 62,640, which rounds UP to the next multiple of 100 to give 62,700 - a worked illustration of the PILA convention.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Rounding: Round UP. Contribution base to the whole peso; each contribution value to the next multiple of 100 (Decreto 1990 de 2016 art. 1).

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: Codigo de la administradora de Riesgos Laborales a la cual pertenece el afiliado
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(6) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Occupational-risk insurer to which the employee is affiliated. Normally equal to the employer's ARL in T2R1-014.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: Clase de riesgo en la que se encuentra el afiliado
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Class I to V. Bidirectional with 'Work centre' (T2R2-062): the class follows the work centre, so a VCT event can change it mid-period. Recorded defect in an official document: Decreto 1072 de 2015 art. 2.2.4.3.5 prints the class IV initial rate inconsistently with the Decreto 1772 de 1994 art. 13 table; use the Decreto 1772 values (0.522, 1.044, 2.436, 4.350, 6.960).

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(7) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: 4% of the contribution base. NEVER exonerated under ET art. 114-1 - a point that catches many implementations, which assume the exoneration covers all three parafiscals. The only relief available on the CCF is the Ley 1429 de 2010 art. 5 regime flagged in A1-034.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(9) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: 4% of the CCF base. Employer cost in full.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Rounding: Round UP. Contribution base to the whole peso; each contribution value to the next multiple of 100 (Decreto 1990 de 2016 art. 1).

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: ZERO where the employee is exonerated under ET art. 114-1 - that is, where 'Contributor exonerated from payment' (T2R2-076) is marked and the employee earns less than 10 SMMLV. Bidirectional set with T2R2-076 and with A1-033.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(7) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: 2% of the parafiscal base, or 0% where the art. 114-1 exoneration applies.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Zero where the art. 114-1 exoneration applies. Bidirectional pair with T2R2-066 and with T2R2-076.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(9) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: 2% of the parafiscal base in T2R2-095, or nil under the exoneration. Employer cost.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Rounding: Round UP. Contribution base to the whole peso; each contribution value to the next multiple of 100 (Decreto 1990 de 2016 art. 1).

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: ZERO where the art. 114-1 exoneration applies. Bidirectional set with T2R2-076 and A1-033.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(7) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: 3% of the parafiscal base, or 0% under the exoneration.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Zero where the art. 114-1 exoneration applies. Bidirectional pair with T2R2-068 and with T2R2-076.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(9) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: 3% of the parafiscal base in T2R2-095, or nil under the exoneration. Employer cost.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Rounding: Round UP. Contribution base to the whole peso; each contribution value to the next multiple of 100 (Decreto 1990 de 2016 art. 1).

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Applies to PUBLIC-SECTOR employers only. Zero for private-sector corporate payroll.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(7) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: 0.5% levy for the Escuela Superior de Administracion Publica. Out of scope for private-sector payroll; the field is still present in the record and must be zero-filled.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Public-sector employers only. Zero for private-sector corporate payroll.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(9) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: ESAP levy value. Zero-filled for the in-scope population.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Rounding: Round UP. Contribution base to the whole peso; each contribution value to the next multiple of 100 (Decreto 1990 de 2016 art. 1).

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Applies to PUBLIC-SECTOR employers only. Zero for private-sector corporate payroll.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(7) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: 1% levy for the Ministerio de Educacion Nacional (escuelas industriales e institutos tecnicos). Out of scope for private-sector payroll.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Public-sector employers only. Zero for private-sector corporate payroll.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(9) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: MEN levy value. Zero-filled for the in-scope population.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Rounding: Round UP. Contribution base to the whole peso; each contribution value to the next multiple of 100 (Decreto 1990 de 2016 art. 1).

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: Tipo de documento del cotizante principal
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Populated only for a dependent beneficiary record - typically contributor type 40. Bidirectional pair with 'Principal contributor identification number' (T2R2-075) and with 'Contributor type' (T2R2-005).
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(2) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Document type of the principal contributor to whom this beneficiary attaches.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: Numero de identificacion del cotizante principal
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Populated only for a dependent beneficiary record. Bidirectional pair with T2R2-074.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(16) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Identification number of the principal contributor.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Marked where THIS EMPLOYEE, in THIS MONTH, earns less than 10 SMMLV (COP 17,509,050 in 2026) and the employer has declared itself exonerated in Archivo Tipo 1 campo 33. Bidirectional set with A1-033 and with the SENA and ICBF rate and value fields T2R2-066 to T2R2-069 and the health rate T2R2-054, all of which must be consistent with it. HARD RULE printed at annex s.2.1.2.3.39: where 'Health contribution base' (T2R2-043) is at or above 10 SMMLV this field MUST be N - and likewise where a NATURAL-person employer employs two or more workers and the health base reaches 10 SMMLV.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: THE PER-EMPLOYEE, PER-MONTH SIDE of the ET art. 114-1 exoneration (introduced by Ley 1607 de 2012 and confirmed by Ley 1819 de 2016 art. 65). Values are S and N, not X. The employer-level flag in A1-033 declares eligibility; THIS field applies it to a specific employee in a specific month. The test is monthly, so an employee who crosses 10 SMMLV because of a bonus loses the exoneration for that month alone - the engine must evaluate it every period, never once a year. Where marked S, the employer's health 8.5%, SENA 2% and ICBF 3% fall away and the health rate in T2R2-054 becomes the EMPLOYEE rate alone (4%); pension, occupational risk and the CCF 4% remain payable in full.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..QueryRA: DEFECT IN THE OFFICIAL ANNEX, recorded. Section 2.1.2.3.21 (campo 54) refers to the exoneration flag as 'el campo 72 Cotizante exonerado de pago de aporte Salud, SENA e ICBF' of Registro Tipo 2, but campo 72 is 'Tarifa aportes MEN'; the exoneration flag is campo 76, as section 2.1.2.3.39 itself correctly states. The layout table is authoritative; the cross-reference in s.2.1.2.3.21 is wrong. Confirm with the RA that no operador has implemented the erroneous reference.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Populated where a non-standard pension rate applies - notably a high-risk activity under Decreto Ley 2090 de 2003. Bidirectional pair with 'Pension contribution rate' (T2R2-046).
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(1) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Signals that the pension rate in T2R2-046 departs from the standard 16%. Corresponds to the nomina electronica AltoRiesgoPension flag (NIE043). See CO-GAP-02 before use.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..QueryRA: CO-GAP-02: the additional high-risk employer pension rate and its base were not confirmed from a primary 2026 source. Verify before configuring any high-risk employee.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Populated for part-time contributors - notably contributor type 51 (Trabajador de tiempo parcial). Bidirectional pair with 'Contributor type' (T2R2-005).
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: N(3) - numeric, right-justified, ZERO-filled to the left
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Hours worked in the period, used for the partial-time contribution regime where the base is not simply floored at 1 SMMLV. Three positions, so a maximum of 999 hours.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Mandatory where 'ING - hire' (T2R2-015) is marked. Bidirectional pair with T2R2-015.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(10) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Date of entry, format AAAA-MM-DD. Should equal nomina electronica FechaIngreso (NIE002).

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Mandatory where 'RET - termination' (T2R2-016) is marked. Bidirectional pair with T2R2-016.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(10) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Date of exit, format AAAA-MM-DD. Should equal nomina electronica FechaRetiro (NIE003).

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Mandatory where 'VSP - permanent salary variation' (T2R2-021) is marked. Bidirectional pair with T2R2-021.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(10) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Effective date of the permanent salary variation, format AAAA-MM-DD. Only a start date - a permanent variation has no end.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Mandatory where 'SLN - suspension or unpaid leave' (T2R2-024) is marked. Bidirectional set with T2R2-024 and T2R2-084.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(10) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: First day of the suspension or unpaid leave, format AAAA-MM-DD.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Mandatory where 'SLN' (T2R2-024) is marked. Bidirectional set with T2R2-024 and T2R2-083.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(10) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Last day of the suspension or unpaid leave.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Mandatory where 'IGE' (T2R2-025) is marked. Bidirectional set with T2R2-025 and T2R2-086.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(10) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: First day of the general-illness incapacity.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Mandatory where 'IGE' (T2R2-025) is marked. Bidirectional set with T2R2-025 and T2R2-085.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(10) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Last day of the general-illness incapacity.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Mandatory where 'LMA' (T2R2-026) is marked. Bidirectional set with T2R2-026 and T2R2-088.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(10) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: First day of maternity or paternity leave.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Mandatory where 'LMA' (T2R2-026) is marked. Bidirectional set with T2R2-026 and T2R2-087.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(10) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: Last day of maternity or paternity leave.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..CondReason: Mandatory where 'VAC-LR' (T2R2-027) carries X or L. Bidirectional set with T2R2-027 and T2R2-090.
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Format: A(10) - alphanumeric, left-justified, SPACE-filled to the right
CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..Explanation: First day of vacation or remunerated leave.

CO-PILA-003-AportesSeguridadSocial-Spec..ES: Fecha fin VAC - LR Formato (AAAA- MM-DD).
